## Get customer entitlement history

<a id="opIdgetCustomerEntitlementHistoryV2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://openmeter.cloud/api/v2/customers/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH/entitlements/string/history?windowSize=MINUTE' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/v2/customers/{customerIdOrKey}/entitlements/{entitlementIdOrFeatureKey}/history`

Returns historical balance and usage data for the entitlement. The queried history can span accross multiple reset events.

BurndownHistory returns a continous history of segments, where the segments are seperated by events that changed either the grant burndown priority or the usage period.

WindowedHistory returns windowed usage data for the period enriched with balance information and the list of grants that were being burnt down in that window.

<h3 id="get-customer-entitlement-history-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customerIdOrKey|path|[ULIDOrExternalKey](#schemaulidorexternalkey)|true|none|
|entitlementIdOrFeatureKey|path|string|true|none|
|from|query|string(date-time)|false|Start of time range to query entitlement: date-time in RFC 3339 format. Defaults to the last reset. Gets truncated to the granularity of the underlying meter.|
|to|query|string(date-time)|false|End of time range to query entitlement: date-time in RFC 3339 format. Defaults to now.<br>If not now then gets truncated to the granularity of the underlying meter.|
|windowSize|query|[WindowSize](#schemawindowsize)|true|Windowsize|
|windowTimeZone|query|string|false|The timezone used when calculating the windows.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|windowSize|MINUTE|
|windowSize|HOUR|
|windowSize|DAY|
|windowSize|MONTH|

`PUT /api/v2/customers/{customerIdOrKey}/entitlements/{entitlementIdOrFeatureKey}/override`

Overriding an entitlement creates a new entitlement from the provided inputs and soft deletes the previous entitlement for the provided customer-feature pair. If the previous entitlement is already deleted or otherwise doesnt exist, the override will fail.

This endpoint is useful for upgrades, downgrades, or other changes to entitlements that require a new entitlement to be created with zero downtime.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "featureKey": "example-feature-key",
  "featureId": "01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV",
  "metadata": {
    "externalId": "019142cc-a016-796a-8113-1a942fecd26d"
  },
  "type": "metered",
  "isSoftLimit": false,
  "usagePeriod": {
    "interval": "DAY",
    "anchor": "2023-01-01T01:01:01.001Z"
  },
  "measureUsageFrom": {},
  "preserveOverageAtReset": false,
  "issueAfterReset": 0,
  "issueAfterResetPriority": 1,
  "issue": {
    "amount": 0,
    "priority": 1
  },
  "grants": [
    {
      "amount": 100,
      "priority": 1,
      "effectiveAt": "2023-01-01T01:01:01.001Z",
      "minRolloverAmount": 100,
      "metadata": {
        "stripePaymentId": "pi_4OrAkhLvyihio9p51h9iiFnB"
      },
      "recurrence": {
        "interval": "DAY",
        "anchor": "2023-01-01T01:01:01.001Z"
      },
      "maxRolloverAmount": 100,
      "expiration": {
        "duration": {},
        "count": 12
      },
      "annotations": {
        "internal_reference": "internal_reference"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|

## Reset customer entitlement

<a id="opIdresetCustomerEntitlementUsageV2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v2/customers/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH/entitlements/string/reset \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/problem+json' \
  -d '{
    "effectiveAt": "2023-01-01T01:01:01.001Z",
    "retainAnchor": true,
    "preserveOverage": true
  }'
```

`POST /api/v2/customers/{customerIdOrKey}/entitlements/{entitlementIdOrFeatureKey}/reset`

Reset marks the start of a new usage period for the entitlement and initiates grant rollover. At the start of a period usage is zerod out and grants are rolled over based on their rollover settings. It would typically be synced with the customers billing period to enforce usage based on their subscription.

Usage is automatically reset for metered entitlements based on their usage period, but this endpoint allows to manually reset it at any time. When doing so the period anchor of the entitlement can be changed if needed.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "effectiveAt": "2023-01-01T01:01:01.001Z",
  "retainAnchor": true,
  "preserveOverage": true
}
```

<h3 id="reset-customer-entitlement-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customerIdOrKey|path|[ULIDOrExternalKey](#schemaulidorexternalkey)|true|none|
|entitlementIdOrFeatureKey|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[ResetEntitlementUsageInput](#schemaresetentitlementusageinput)|true|none|
|» effectiveAt|body|string(date-time)|false|The time at which the reset takes effect, defaults to now. The reset cannot be in the future. The provided value is truncated to the minute due to how historical meter data is stored.|
|» retainAnchor|body|boolean|false|Determines whether the usage period anchor is retained or reset to the effectiveAt time.<br>- If true, the usage period anchor is retained.<br>- If false, the usage period anchor is reset to the effectiveAt time.|
|» preserveOverage|body|boolean|false|Determines whether the overage is preserved or forgiven, overriding the entitlement's default behavior.<br>- If true, the overage is preserved.<br>- If false, the overage is forgiven.|

`GET /api/v2/customers/{customerIdOrKey}/entitlements/{entitlementIdOrFeatureKey}/value`

|entitlementIdOrFeatureKey|path|string|true|none|
|time|query|string(date-time)|false|none|

## List all entitlements

<a id="opIdlistEntitlementsV2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v2/entitlements \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/v2/entitlements`

List all entitlements for all the customers and features. This endpoint is intended for administrative purposes only.
To fetch the entitlements of a specific subject please use the /api/v2/customers/{customerIdOrKey}/entitlements endpoint.

<h3 id="list-all-entitlements-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|feature|query|[string]|false|Filtering by multiple features.<br><br>Usage: `?feature=feature-1&feature=feature-2`|
|customerKeys|query|[string]|false|Filtering by multiple customers.<br><br>Usage: `?customerKeys=customer-1&customerKeys=customer-3`|
|customerIds|query|[string]|false|Filtering by multiple customers.<br><br>Usage: `?customerIds=01K4WAQ0J99ZZ0MD75HXR112H8&customerIds=01K4WAQ0J99ZZ0MD75HXR112H9`|
|entitlementType|query|[[EntitlementType](#schemaentitlementtype)]|false|Filtering by multiple entitlement types.<br><br>Usage: `?entitlementType=metered&entitlementType=boolean`|
|excludeInactive|query|boolean|false|Exclude inactive entitlements in the response (those scheduled for later or earlier)|
|page|query|integer|false|Page index.<br><br>Default is 1.|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|The maximum number of items per page.<br><br>Default is 100.|
|offset|query|integer|false|Number of items to skip.<br><br>Default is 0.|
|limit|query|integer|false|Number of items to return.<br><br>Default is 100.|
|order|query|object|false|The order direction.|
|orderBy|query|[EntitlementOrderBy](#schemaentitlementorderby)|false|The order by field.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|entitlementType|metered|
|entitlementType|boolean|
|entitlementType|static|
|orderBy|createdAt|
|orderBy|updatedAt|

## List grants

<a id="opIdlistGrantsV2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v2/grants \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/v2/grants`

List all grants for all the customers and entitlements. This endpoint is intended for administrative purposes only.
To fetch the grants of a specific entitlement please use the /api/v2/customers/{customerIdOrKey}/entitlements/{entitlementIdOrFeatureKey}/grants endpoint.
If page is provided that takes precedence and the paginated response is returned.

<h3 id="list-grants-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|feature|query|[string]|false|Filtering by multiple features.<br><br>Usage: `?feature=feature-1&feature=feature-2`|
|customer|query|[[ULIDOrExternalKey](#schemaulidorexternalkey)]|false|Filtering by multiple customers (either by ID or key).<br><br>Usage: `?customer=customer-1&customer=customer-2`|
|includeDeleted|query|boolean|false|Include deleted|
|page|query|integer|false|Page index.<br><br>Default is 1.|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|The maximum number of items per page.<br><br>Default is 100.|
|offset|query|integer|false|Number of items to skip.<br><br>Default is 0.|
|limit|query|integer|false|Number of items to return.<br><br>Default is 100.|
|order|query|object|false|The order direction.|
|orderBy|query|[GrantOrderBy](#schemagrantorderby)|false|The order by field.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|orderBy|id|
|orderBy|createdAt|
|orderBy|updatedAt|

<a id="opIdlistCustomers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/customers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/v1/customers`

List customers.

<h3 id="list-customers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Page index.<br><br>Default is 1.|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|The maximum number of items per page.<br><br>Default is 100.|
|order|query|object|false|The order direction.|
|orderBy|query|[CustomerOrderBy](#schemacustomerorderby)|false|The order by field.|
|includeDeleted|query|boolean|false|Include deleted customers.|
|key|query|string|false|Filter customers by key.<br>Case-insensitive partial match.|
|name|query|string|false|Filter customers by name.<br>Case-insensitive partial match.|
|primaryEmail|query|string|false|Filter customers by primary email.<br>Case-insensitive partial match.|
|subject|query|string|false|Filter customers by usage attribution subject.<br>Case-insensitive partial match.|
|planKey|query|string|false|Filter customers by the plan key of their susbcription.|
|expand|query|[[CustomerExpand](#schemacustomerexpand)]|false|What parts of the list output to expand in listings|

## Create Stripe customer portal session

<a id="opIdcreateCustomerStripePortalSession"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/customers/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH/stripe/portal \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "configurationId": "string",
    "locale": "string",
    "returnUrl": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /api/v1/customers/{customerIdOrKey}/stripe/portal`

Create Stripe customer portal session.
Only returns URL if the customer billing profile is linked to a stripe app and customer.

Useful to redirect the customer to the Stripe customer portal to manage their payment methods,
change their billing address and access their invoice history.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "configurationId": "string",
  "locale": "string",
  "returnUrl": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-stripe-customer-portal-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customerIdOrKey|path|[ULIDOrExternalKey](#schemaulidorexternalkey)|true|none|
|body|body|[CreateStripeCustomerPortalSessionParams](#schemacreatestripecustomerportalsessionparams)|true|none|
|» configurationId|body|string|false|The ID of an existing configuration to use for this session,<br>describing its functionality and features.<br>If not specified, the session uses the default configuration.<br><br>See https://docs.stripe.com/api/customer_portal/sessions/create#create_portal_session-configuration|
|» locale|body|string|false|The IETF language tag of the locale customer portal is displayed in.<br>If blank or auto, the customer’s preferred_locales or browser’s locale is used.<br><br>See: https://docs.stripe.com/api/customer_portal/sessions/create#create_portal_session-locale|
|» returnUrl|body|string|false|The URL to redirect the customer to after they have completed<br>their requested actions.<br><br>See: https://docs.stripe.com/api/customer_portal/sessions/create#create_portal_session-return_url|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "stripeCustomerId": "string",
  "configurationId": "string",
  "livemode": true,

  "returnUrl": "string",
```

<h1 id="openmeter-api-billing">Billing</h1>

Manage your billing profiles and invoices. 

## List customer overrides

<a id="opIdlistBillingProfileCustomerOverrides"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/customers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/v1/billing/customers`

List customer overrides using the specified filters.

The response will include the customer override values and the merged billing profile values.

If the includeAllCustomers is set to true, the list contains all customers. This mode is
useful for getting the current effective billing workflow settings for all users regardless
if they have customer orverrides or not.

<h3 id="list-customer-overrides-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|billingProfile|query|[string]|false|Filter by billing profile.|
|customersWithoutPinnedProfile|query|boolean|false|Only return customers without pinned billing profiles. This implicitly sets includeAllCustomers to true.|
|includeAllCustomers|query|boolean|false|Include customers without customer overrides.<br><br>If set to false only the customers specifically associated with a billing profile will be returned.<br><br>If set to true, in case of the default billing profile, all customers will be returned.|
|customerId|query|[string]|false|Filter by customer id.|
|customerName|query|string|false|Filter by customer name.|
|customerKey|query|string|false|Filter by customer key|
|customerPrimaryEmail|query|string|false|Filter by customer primary email|
|expand|query|[[BillingProfileCustomerOverrideExpand](#schemabillingprofilecustomeroverrideexpand)]|false|Expand the response with additional details.|
|order|query|object|false|The order direction.|
|orderBy|query|[BillingProfileCustomerOverrideOrderBy](#schemabillingprofilecustomeroverrideorderby)|false|The order by field.|
|page|query|integer|false|Page index.<br><br>Default is 1.|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|The maximum number of items per page.<br><br>Default is 100.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|expand|apps|
|expand|customer|
|orderBy|customerId|
|orderBy|customerName|
|orderBy|customerKey|
|orderBy|customerPrimaryEmail|
|orderBy|customerCreatedAt|

## Get a customer override

<a id="opIdgetBillingProfileCustomerOverride"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/customers/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/v1/billing/customers/{customerId}`

Get a customer override by customer id.

The response will include the customer override values and the merged billing profile values.

If the customer override is not found, the default billing profile's values are returned. This behavior
allows for getting a merged profile regardless of the customer override existence.

<h3 id="get-a-customer-override-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customerId|path|string|true|none|
|expand|query|[[BillingProfileCustomerOverrideExpand](#schemabillingprofilecustomeroverrideexpand)]|false|none|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|expand|apps|
|expand|customer|

## Create a new or update a customer override

<a id="opIdupsertBillingProfileCustomerOverride"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/customers/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "billingProfileId": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
  }'
```

`PUT /api/v1/billing/customers/{customerId}`

The customer override can be used to pin a given customer to a billing profile
different from the default one.

This can be used to test the effect of different billing profiles before making them
the default ones or have different workflow settings for example for enterprise customers.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "billingProfileId": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-new-or-update-a-customer-override-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customerId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[BillingProfileCustomerOverrideCreate](#schemabillingprofilecustomeroverridecreate)|true|none|
|» billingProfileId|body|string|false|The billing profile this override is associated with.<br><br>If not provided, the default billing profile is chosen if available.|

## Delete a customer override

<a id="opIddeleteBillingProfileCustomerOverride"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/customers/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/problem+json'
```

`DELETE /api/v1/billing/customers/{customerId}`

Delete a customer override by customer id.

This will remove the customer override and the customer will be subject to the default
billing profile's settings again.

<h3 id="delete-a-customer-override-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|---|---|---|---|---|
|customerId|path|string|true|none|

`POST /api/v1/billing/customers/{customerId}/invoices/pending-lines`

Create a new pending line item (charge).

This call is used to create a new pending line item for the customer if required a new
gathering invoice will be created.

A new invoice will be created if:
- there is no invoice in gathering state
- the currency of the line item doesn't match the currency of any invoices in gathering state

`POST /api/v1/billing/customers/{customerId}/invoices/simulate`

Simulate an invoice for a customer.

This call will simulate an invoice for a customer based on the pending line items.

The call will return the total amount of the invoice and the line items that will be included in the invoice.

> Body parameter

<h3 id="simulate-an-invoice-for-a-customer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customerId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[InvoiceSimulationInput](#schemainvoicesimulationinput)|true|none|
|» number|body|object|false|The number of the invoice.|
|» currency|body|object|true|Currency for all invoice line items.<br><br>Multi currency invoices are not supported yet.|
|» lines|body|[[InvoiceSimulationLine](#schemainvoicesimulationline)]|true|Lines to be included in the generated invoice.|

<h3 id="simulate-an-invoice-for-a-customer-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The request has succeeded.|[Invoice](#schemainvoice)|
|400|Bad Request|The server cannot or will not process the request due to something that is perceived to be a client error (e.g., malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing, or deceptive request routing).|[BadRequestProblemResponse](#schemabadrequestproblemresponse)|
|401|Unauthorized|The request has not been applied because it lacks valid authentication credentials for the target resource.|[UnauthorizedProblemResponse](#schemaunauthorizedproblemresponse)|
|403|Forbidden|The server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.|[ForbiddenProblemResponse](#schemaforbiddenproblemresponse)|
|412|Precondition Failed|One or more conditions given in the request header fields evaluated to false when tested on the server.|[PreconditionFailedProblemResponse](#schemapreconditionfailedproblemresponse)|
|500|Internal Server Error|The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.|[InternalServerErrorProblemResponse](#schemainternalservererrorproblemresponse)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance, which will likely be alleviated after some delay.|[ServiceUnavailableProblemResponse](#schemaserviceunavailableproblemresponse)|
|default|Default|An unexpected error response.|[UnexpectedProblemResponse](#schemaunexpectedproblemresponse)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## List invoices

<a id="opIdlistInvoices"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/invoices \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/v1/billing/invoices`

List invoices based on the specified filters.

The expand option can be used to include additional information (besides the invoice header and totals)
in the response. For example by adding the expand=lines option the invoice lines will be included in the response.

Gathering invoices will always show the current usage calculated on the fly.

<h3 id="list-invoices-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|statuses|query|[[InvoiceStatus](#schemainvoicestatus)]|false|Filter by the invoice status.|
|extendedStatuses|query|[string]|false|Filter by invoice extended statuses|
|issuedAfter|query|string(date-time)|false|Filter by invoice issued time.<br>Inclusive.|
|issuedBefore|query|string(date-time)|false|Filter by invoice issued time.<br>Inclusive.|
|periodStartAfter|query|string(date-time)|false|Filter by period start time.<br>Inclusive.|
|periodStartBefore|query|string(date-time)|false|Filter by period start time.<br>Inclusive.|
|createdAfter|query|string(date-time)|false|Filter by invoice created time.<br>Inclusive.|
|createdBefore|query|string(date-time)|false|Filter by invoice created time.<br>Inclusive.|
|expand|query|[[InvoiceExpand](#schemainvoiceexpand)]|false|What parts of the list output to expand in listings|
|customers|query|[string]|false|Filter by customer ID|
|includeDeleted|query|boolean|false|Include deleted invoices|
|page|query|integer|false|Page index.<br><br>Default is 1.|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|The maximum number of items per page.<br><br>Default is 100.|
|order|query|object|false|The order direction.|
|orderBy|query|[InvoiceOrderBy](#schemainvoiceorderby)|false|The order by field.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|statuses|gathering|
|statuses|draft|
|statuses|issuing|
|statuses|issued|
|statuses|payment_processing|
|statuses|overdue|
|statuses|paid|
|statuses|uncollectible|
|statuses|voided|
|expand|lines|
|expand|preceding|
|expand|workflow.apps|
|orderBy|customer.name|
|orderBy|issuedAt|
|orderBy|status|
|orderBy|createdAt|
|orderBy|updatedAt|
|orderBy|periodStart|

## Invoice a customer based on the pending line items

<a id="opIdinvoicePendingLinesAction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/invoices/invoice \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "filters": {
      "lineIds": [
        "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
      ]
    },
    "asOf": "2023-01-01T01:01:01.001Z",
    "customerId": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH",
    "progressiveBillingOverride": true
  }'
```

`POST /api/v1/billing/invoices/invoice`

Create a new invoice from the pending line items.

This should be only called if for some reason we need to invoice a customer outside of the normal billing cycle.

When creating an invoice, the pending line items will be marked as invoiced and the invoice will be created with the total amount of the pending items.

New pending line items will be created for the period between now() and the next billing cycle's begining date for any metered item.

The call can return multiple invoices if the pending line items are in different currencies.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "filters": {
    "lineIds": [
      "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
    ]
  },
  "asOf": "2023-01-01T01:01:01.001Z",
  "customerId": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH",
  "progressiveBillingOverride": true
}
```

<h3 id="invoice-a-customer-based-on-the-pending-line-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[InvoicePendingLinesActionInput](#schemainvoicependinglinesactioninput)|true|none|
|» filters|body|object|false|Filters to apply when creating the invoice.|
|» » lineIds|body|[string]|false|The pending line items to include in the invoice, if not provided:<br>- all line items that have invoice_at < asOf will be included<br>- [progressive billing only] all usage based line items will be included up to asOf, new<br>usage-based line items will be staged for the rest of the billing cycle<br><br>All lineIDs present in the list, must exists and must be invoicable as of asOf, or the action will fail.|
|» asOf|body|string(date-time)|false|The time as of which the invoice is created.<br><br>If not provided, the current time is used.|
|» customerId|body|string|true|The customer ID for which to create the invoice.|
|» progressiveBillingOverride|body|boolean|false|Override the progressive billing setting of the customer.<br><br>Can be used to disable/enable progressive billing in case the business logic<br>requires it, if not provided the billing profile's progressive billing setting will be used.|

```json
  {
    "id": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH",
    "description": "string",
    "metadata": {
```

<h3 id="invoice-a-customer-based-on-the-pending-line-items-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|The request has succeeded and a new resource has been created as a result.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|The server cannot or will not process the request due to something that is perceived to be a client error (e.g., malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing, or deceptive request routing).|[BadRequestProblemResponse](#schemabadrequestproblemresponse)|
|401|Unauthorized|The request has not been applied because it lacks valid authentication credentials for the target resource.|[UnauthorizedProblemResponse](#schemaunauthorizedproblemresponse)|
|403|Forbidden|The server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.|[ForbiddenProblemResponse](#schemaforbiddenproblemresponse)|
|412|Precondition Failed|One or more conditions given in the request header fields evaluated to false when tested on the server.|[PreconditionFailedProblemResponse](#schemapreconditionfailedproblemresponse)|
|500|Internal Server Error|The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.|[InternalServerErrorProblemResponse](#schemainternalservererrorproblemresponse)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance, which will likely be alleviated after some delay.|[ServiceUnavailableProblemResponse](#schemaserviceunavailableproblemresponse)|
|default|Default|An unexpected error response.|[UnexpectedProblemResponse](#schemaunexpectedproblemresponse)|

<h3 id="invoice-a-customer-based-on-the-pending-line-items-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*anonymous*|[[Invoice](#schemainvoice)]|false|none|none|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get an invoice

<a id="opIdgetInvoice"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/invoices/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/v1/billing/invoices/{invoiceId}`

Get an invoice by ID.

Gathering invoices will always show the current usage calculated on the fly.

<h3 id="get-an-invoice-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoiceId|path|string|true|none|
|expand|query|[[InvoiceExpand](#schemainvoiceexpand)]|false|none|
|includeDeletedLines|query|boolean|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|expand|lines|
|expand|preceding|
|expand|workflow.apps|

> Example responses

<h3 id="get-an-invoice-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The request has succeeded.|[Invoice](#schemainvoice)|
|400|Bad Request|The server cannot or will not process the request due to something that is perceived to be a client error (e.g., malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing, or deceptive request routing).|[BadRequestProblemResponse](#schemabadrequestproblemresponse)|
|401|Unauthorized|The request has not been applied because it lacks valid authentication credentials for the target resource.|[UnauthorizedProblemResponse](#schemaunauthorizedproblemresponse)|
|403|Forbidden|The server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.|[ForbiddenProblemResponse](#schemaforbiddenproblemresponse)|
|404|Not Found|The origin server did not find a current representation for the target resource or is not willing to disclose that one exists.|[NotFoundProblemResponse](#schemanotfoundproblemresponse)|
|412|Precondition Failed|One or more conditions given in the request header fields evaluated to false when tested on the server.|[PreconditionFailedProblemResponse](#schemapreconditionfailedproblemresponse)|
|500|Internal Server Error|The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.|[InternalServerErrorProblemResponse](#schemainternalservererrorproblemresponse)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance, which will likely be alleviated after some delay.|[ServiceUnavailableProblemResponse](#schemaserviceunavailableproblemresponse)|
|default|Default|An unexpected error response.|[UnexpectedProblemResponse](#schemaunexpectedproblemresponse)|

`PUT /api/v1/billing/invoices/{invoiceId}`

<h3 id="update-an-invoice-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoiceId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[InvoiceReplaceUpdate](#schemainvoicereplaceupdate)|true|none|
|» description|body|string|false|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|» metadata|body|object \| null|false|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» supplier|body|object|true|The supplier of the lines included in the invoice.|
|» » key|body|string|false|An optional unique key of the party (if available)|
|» » name|body|string|false|Legal name or representation of the organization.|
|» » taxId|body|object|false|The entity's legal ID code used for tax purposes. They may have<br>other numbers, but we're only interested in those valid for tax purposes.|
|» » » code|body|object|false|Normalized tax code shown on the original identity document.|
|» » addresses|body|[[Address](#schemaaddress)]|false|Regular post addresses for where information should be sent if needed.|
|» customer|body|object|true|The customer the invoice is sent to.|
|» » key|body|string|false|An optional unique key of the party (if available)|
|» » name|body|string|false|Legal name or representation of the organization.|
|» » taxId|body|object|false|The entity's legal ID code used for tax purposes. They may have<br>other numbers, but we're only interested in those valid for tax purposes.|
|» » » code|body|object|false|Normalized tax code shown on the original identity document.|
|» » addresses|body|[[Address](#schemaaddress)]|false|Regular post addresses for where information should be sent if needed.|
|» lines|body|[[InvoiceLineReplaceUpdate](#schemainvoicelinereplaceupdate)]|true|The lines included in the invoice.|
|» workflow|body|object|true|The workflow settings for the invoice.|
|» » workflow|body|object|true|The workflow used for this invoice.|
|» » » invoicing|body|object|true|The invoicing settings for this workflow|
|» » » » autoAdvance|body|boolean|false|Whether to automatically issue the invoice after the draftPeriod has passed.|
|» » » » draftPeriod|body|string(ISO8601)|false|The period for the invoice to be kept in draft status for manual reviews.|
|» » » » dueAfter|body|string(ISO8601)|false|The period after which the invoice is due.<br>With some payment solutions it's only applicable for manual collection method.|
|» » » » subscriptionEndProrationMode|body|object|false|Controls how subscription-ending shortened service periods are billed.|
|» » » » defaultTaxConfig|body|object|false|Default tax configuration to apply to the invoices.<br><br>Setting a tax code (`stripe.code` / `taxCodeId`) on a profile's default tax config is<br>deprecated and can no longer be added or changed: the organization default tax code is<br>used instead. Existing tax-code values may still be removed, and `behavior` remains<br>fully supported.|
|» » » » » behavior|body|object|false|Tax behavior.<br><br>If not specified the billing profile is used to determine the tax behavior.<br>If not specified in the billing profile, the provider's default behavior is used.|
|» » » » » stripe|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Stripe tax config.|
|» » » » » » code|body|string|true|Product tax code.<br><br>See: https://docs.stripe.com/tax/tax-codes|
|» » » » » customInvoicing|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Custom invoicing tax config.|
|» » » » » » code|body|string|true|Tax code.<br><br>The tax code should be interpreted by the custom invoicing provider.|
|» » » » » taxCodeId|body|string|false|Tax code reference.<br><br>When both `taxCodeId` and `stripe.code` are provided, `taxCodeId` takes precedence:<br>the referenced tax code entity is used and `stripe.code` is ignored.|
|» » » payment|body|object|true|The payment settings for this workflow|
|» » » » collectionMethod|body|object|false|The payment method for the invoice.|

## Delete an invoice

<a id="opIddeleteInvoice"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/invoices/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/problem+json'
```

`DELETE /api/v1/billing/invoices/{invoiceId}`

Delete an invoice

Only invoices that are in the draft (or earlier) status can be deleted.

Invoices that are post finalization can only be voided.

<h3 id="delete-an-invoice-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoiceId|path|string|true|none|

## Advance the invoice's state to the next status

<a id="opIdadvanceInvoiceAction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/invoices/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH/advance \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /api/v1/billing/invoices/{invoiceId}/advance`

Advance the invoice's state to the next status.

The call doesn't "approve the invoice", it only advances the invoice to the next status if the transition would be automatic.

The action can be called when the invoice's statusDetails' actions field contain the "advance" action.

<h3 id="advance-the-invoices-state-to-the-next-status-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoiceId|path|string|true|none|

<h3 id="advance-the-invoices-state-to-the-next-status-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The request has succeeded.|[Invoice](#schemainvoice)|
|400|Bad Request|The server cannot or will not process the request due to something that is perceived to be a client error (e.g., malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing, or deceptive request routing).|[BadRequestProblemResponse](#schemabadrequestproblemresponse)|
|401|Unauthorized|The request has not been applied because it lacks valid authentication credentials for the target resource.|[UnauthorizedProblemResponse](#schemaunauthorizedproblemresponse)|
|403|Forbidden|The server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.|[ForbiddenProblemResponse](#schemaforbiddenproblemresponse)|
|404|Not Found|The origin server did not find a current representation for the target resource or is not willing to disclose that one exists.|[NotFoundProblemResponse](#schemanotfoundproblemresponse)|
|412|Precondition Failed|One or more conditions given in the request header fields evaluated to false when tested on the server.|[PreconditionFailedProblemResponse](#schemapreconditionfailedproblemresponse)|
|500|Internal Server Error|The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.|[InternalServerErrorProblemResponse](#schemainternalservererrorproblemresponse)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance, which will likely be alleviated after some delay.|[ServiceUnavailableProblemResponse](#schemaserviceunavailableproblemresponse)|
|default|Default|An unexpected error response.|[UnexpectedProblemResponse](#schemaunexpectedproblemresponse)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Send the invoice to the customer

<a id="opIdapproveInvoiceAction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/invoices/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH/approve \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /api/v1/billing/invoices/{invoiceId}/approve`

Approve an invoice and start executing the payment workflow.

This call instantly sends the invoice to the customer using the configured billing profile app.

This call is valid in two invoice statuses:
- `draft`: the invoice will be sent to the customer, the invluce state becomes issued
- `manual_approval_needed`: the invoice will be sent to the customer, the invoice state becomes issued

<h3 id="send-the-invoice-to-the-customer-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoiceId|path|string|true|none|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The request has succeeded.|[Invoice](#schemainvoice)|
|400|Bad Request|The server cannot or will not process the request due to something that is perceived to be a client error (e.g., malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing, or deceptive request routing).|[BadRequestProblemResponse](#schemabadrequestproblemresponse)|
|401|Unauthorized|The request has not been applied because it lacks valid authentication credentials for the target resource.|[UnauthorizedProblemResponse](#schemaunauthorizedproblemresponse)|
|403|Forbidden|The server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.|[ForbiddenProblemResponse](#schemaforbiddenproblemresponse)|
|404|Not Found|The origin server did not find a current representation for the target resource or is not willing to disclose that one exists.|[NotFoundProblemResponse](#schemanotfoundproblemresponse)|
|412|Precondition Failed|One or more conditions given in the request header fields evaluated to false when tested on the server.|[PreconditionFailedProblemResponse](#schemapreconditionfailedproblemresponse)|
|500|Internal Server Error|The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.|[InternalServerErrorProblemResponse](#schemainternalservererrorproblemresponse)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance, which will likely be alleviated after some delay.|[ServiceUnavailableProblemResponse](#schemaserviceunavailableproblemresponse)|
|default|Default|An unexpected error response.|[UnexpectedProblemResponse](#schemaunexpectedproblemresponse)|

## Retry advancing the invoice after a failed attempt.

<a id="opIdretryInvoiceAction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/invoices/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH/retry \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /api/v1/billing/invoices/{invoiceId}/retry`

Retry advancing the invoice after a failed attempt.

The action can be called when the invoice's statusDetails' actions field contain the "retry" action.

<h3 id="retry-advancing-the-invoice-after-a-failed-attempt-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoiceId|path|string|true|none|

<h3 id="retry-advancing-the-invoice-after-a-failed-attempt-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The request has succeeded.|[Invoice](#schemainvoice)|
|400|Bad Request|The server cannot or will not process the request due to something that is perceived to be a client error (e.g., malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing, or deceptive request routing).|[BadRequestProblemResponse](#schemabadrequestproblemresponse)|
|401|Unauthorized|The request has not been applied because it lacks valid authentication credentials for the target resource.|[UnauthorizedProblemResponse](#schemaunauthorizedproblemresponse)|
|403|Forbidden|The server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.|[ForbiddenProblemResponse](#schemaforbiddenproblemresponse)|
|404|Not Found|The origin server did not find a current representation for the target resource or is not willing to disclose that one exists.|[NotFoundProblemResponse](#schemanotfoundproblemresponse)|
|412|Precondition Failed|One or more conditions given in the request header fields evaluated to false when tested on the server.|[PreconditionFailedProblemResponse](#schemapreconditionfailedproblemresponse)|
|500|Internal Server Error|The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.|[InternalServerErrorProblemResponse](#schemainternalservererrorproblemresponse)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance, which will likely be alleviated after some delay.|[ServiceUnavailableProblemResponse](#schemaserviceunavailableproblemresponse)|
|default|Default|An unexpected error response.|[UnexpectedProblemResponse](#schemaunexpectedproblemresponse)|

## Snapshot quantities for usage based line items

<a id="opIdsnapshotQuantitiesInvoiceAction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/invoices/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH/snapshot-quantities \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /api/v1/billing/invoices/{invoiceId}/snapshot-quantities`

Snapshot quantities for usage based line items.

This call will snapshot the quantities for all usage based line items in the invoice.

This call is only valid in `draft.waiting_for_collection` status, where the collection period
can be skipped using this action.

<h3 id="snapshot-quantities-for-usage-based-line-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoiceId|path|string|true|none|

|---|---|---|---|

|401|Unauthorized|The request has not been applied because it lacks valid authentication credentials for the target resource.|[UnauthorizedProblemResponse](#schemaunauthorizedproblemresponse)|
|403|Forbidden|The server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.|[ForbiddenProblemResponse](#schemaforbiddenproblemresponse)|
|404|Not Found|The origin server did not find a current representation for the target resource or is not willing to disclose that one exists.|[NotFoundProblemResponse](#schemanotfoundproblemresponse)|
|412|Precondition Failed|One or more conditions given in the request header fields evaluated to false when tested on the server.|[PreconditionFailedProblemResponse](#schemapreconditionfailedproblemresponse)|
|500|Internal Server Error|The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.|[InternalServerErrorProblemResponse](#schemainternalservererrorproblemresponse)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance, which will likely be alleviated after some delay.|[ServiceUnavailableProblemResponse](#schemaserviceunavailableproblemresponse)|
|default|Default|An unexpected error response.|[UnexpectedProblemResponse](#schemaunexpectedproblemresponse)|

## Recalculate an invoice's tax amounts

<a id="opIdrecalculateInvoiceTaxAction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/invoices/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH/taxes/recalculate \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`POST /api/v1/billing/invoices/{invoiceId}/taxes/recalculate`

Recalculate an invoice's tax amounts (using the app set in the customer's billing profile)

Note: charges might apply, depending on the tax provider.

<h3 id="recalculate-an-invoices-tax-amounts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoiceId|path|string|true|none|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|

|400|Bad Request|The server cannot or will not process the request due to something that is perceived to be a client error (e.g., malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing, or deceptive request routing).|[BadRequestProblemResponse](#schemabadrequestproblemresponse)|
|401|Unauthorized|The request has not been applied because it lacks valid authentication credentials for the target resource.|[UnauthorizedProblemResponse](#schemaunauthorizedproblemresponse)|
|403|Forbidden|The server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.|[ForbiddenProblemResponse](#schemaforbiddenproblemresponse)|
|404|Not Found|The origin server did not find a current representation for the target resource or is not willing to disclose that one exists.|[NotFoundProblemResponse](#schemanotfoundproblemresponse)|
|412|Precondition Failed|One or more conditions given in the request header fields evaluated to false when tested on the server.|[PreconditionFailedProblemResponse](#schemapreconditionfailedproblemresponse)|
|500|Internal Server Error|The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.|[InternalServerErrorProblemResponse](#schemainternalservererrorproblemresponse)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance, which will likely be alleviated after some delay.|[ServiceUnavailableProblemResponse](#schemaserviceunavailableproblemresponse)|
|default|Default|An unexpected error response.|[UnexpectedProblemResponse](#schemaunexpectedproblemresponse)|

## Void an invoice

<a id="opIdvoidInvoiceAction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/invoices/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH/void \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "action": {
      "percentage": {},
      "action": {
        "type": "discard"
      }
    },
    "reason": "string",
    "overrides": [
      {
        "lineId": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH",
        "action": {
          "percentage": {},
          "action": {
            "type": "discard"
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /api/v1/billing/invoices/{invoiceId}/void`

Void an invoice

Only invoices that have been alread issued can be voided.

Voiding an invoice will mark it as voided, the user can specify how to handle the voided line items.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "action": {
    "percentage": {},
    "action": {
      "type": "discard"
    }
  },
  "reason": "string",
  "overrides": [
    {
      "lineId": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH",
      "action": {
        "percentage": {},
        "action": {
          "type": "discard"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="void-an-invoice-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoiceId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[VoidInvoiceActionInput](#schemavoidinvoiceactioninput)|true|none|
|» action|body|object|true|The action to take on the voided line items.|
|» » percentage|body|object|true|How much of the total line items to be voided? (e.g. 100% means all charges are voided)|
|» » action|body|object|true|The action to take on the line items.|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[VoidInvoiceLineDiscardAction](#schemavoidinvoicelinediscardaction)|false|VoidInvoiceLineDiscardAction describes how to handle the voidied line item in the invoice.|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|[VoidInvoiceLinePendingActionCreate](#schemavoidinvoicelinependingactioncreate)|false|VoidInvoiceLinePendingAction describes how to handle the voidied line item in the invoice.|
|» reason|body|string|true|The reason for voiding the invoice.|
|» overrides|body|[[VoidInvoiceActionLineOverride](#schemavoidinvoiceactionlineoverride)]|false|Per line item overrides for the action.<br><br>If not specified, the `action` will be applied to all line items.|

<h3 id="void-an-invoice-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The request has succeeded.|[Invoice](#schemainvoice)|
|400|Bad Request|The server cannot or will not process the request due to something that is perceived to be a client error (e.g., malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing, or deceptive request routing).|[BadRequestProblemResponse](#schemabadrequestproblemresponse)|
|401|Unauthorized|The request has not been applied because it lacks valid authentication credentials for the target resource.|[UnauthorizedProblemResponse](#schemaunauthorizedproblemresponse)|
|403|Forbidden|The server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.|[ForbiddenProblemResponse](#schemaforbiddenproblemresponse)|
|404|Not Found|The origin server did not find a current representation for the target resource or is not willing to disclose that one exists.|[NotFoundProblemResponse](#schemanotfoundproblemresponse)|
|412|Precondition Failed|One or more conditions given in the request header fields evaluated to false when tested on the server.|[PreconditionFailedProblemResponse](#schemapreconditionfailedproblemresponse)|
|500|Internal Server Error|The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.|[InternalServerErrorProblemResponse](#schemainternalservererrorproblemresponse)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance, which will likely be alleviated after some delay.|[ServiceUnavailableProblemResponse](#schemaserviceunavailableproblemresponse)|
|default|Default|An unexpected error response.|[UnexpectedProblemResponse](#schemaunexpectedproblemresponse)|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## List billing profiles

<a id="opIdlistBillingProfiles"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/profiles \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /api/v1/billing/profiles`

List all billing profiles matching the specified filters.

The expand option can be used to include additional information (besides the billing profile)
in the response. For example by adding the expand=apps option the apps used by the billing profile
will be included in the response.

<h3 id="list-billing-profiles-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|includeArchived|query|boolean|false|none|
|expand|query|[[BillingProfileExpand](#schemabillingprofileexpand)]|false|none|
|page|query|integer|false|Page index.<br><br>Default is 1.|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|The maximum number of items per page.<br><br>Default is 100.|
|order|query|object|false|The order direction.|
|orderBy|query|[BillingProfileOrderBy](#schemabillingprofileorderby)|false|The order by field.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|expand|apps|
|orderBy|createdAt|
|orderBy|updatedAt|
|orderBy|default|
|orderBy|name|

## Create a new billing profile

<a id="opIdcreateBillingProfile"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/profiles \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "description": "string",
    "metadata": {
      "externalId": "019142cc-a016-796a-8113-1a942fecd26d"
    },
    "supplier": {
      "key": "string",
      "name": "string",
      "taxId": {
        "code": {}
      },
      "addresses": [
        {
          "country": {},
          "postalCode": "string",
          "state": "string",
          "city": "string",
          "line1": "string",
          "line2": "string",
          "phoneNumber": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "default": true,
    "workflow": {
      "collection": {
        "alignment": {
          "type": "subscription"
        },
        "interval": "P1D"
      },
      "invoicing": {
        "autoAdvance": true,
        "draftPeriod": "P1D",
        "dueAfter": "P30D",
        "progressiveBilling": true,
        "subscriptionEndProrationMode": "bill_actual_period",
        "defaultTaxConfig": {
          "behavior": {},
          "stripe": {
            "code": "txcd_10000000"
          },
          "customInvoicing": {
            "code": "string"
          },
          "taxCodeId": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
        }
      },
      "payment": {
        "collectionMethod": "charge_automatically"
      },
      "tax": {
        "enabled": true,
        "enforced": false
      }
    },
    "apps": {
      "tax": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH",
      "invoicing": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH",
      "payment": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
    }
  }'
```

`POST /api/v1/billing/profiles`

Create a new billing profile

Billing profiles are representations of a customer's billing information. Customer overrides
can be applied to a billing profile to customize the billing behavior for a specific customer.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "metadata": {
    "externalId": "019142cc-a016-796a-8113-1a942fecd26d"
  },
  "supplier": {
    "key": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "taxId": {
      "code": {}
    },
    "addresses": [
      {
        "country": {},
        "postalCode": "string",
        "state": "string",
        "city": "string",
        "line1": "string",
        "line2": "string",
        "phoneNumber": "string"
      }
    ]
  },
  "default": true,
  "workflow": {
    "collection": {
      "alignment": {
        "type": "subscription"
      },
      "interval": "P1D"
    },
    "invoicing": {
      "autoAdvance": true,
      "draftPeriod": "P1D",
      "dueAfter": "P30D",
      "progressiveBilling": true,
      "subscriptionEndProrationMode": "bill_actual_period",
      "defaultTaxConfig": {
        "behavior": {},
        "stripe": {
          "code": "txcd_10000000"
        },

  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-new-billing-profile-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[BillingProfileCreate](#schemabillingprofilecreate)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Human-readable name for the resource. Between 1 and 256 characters.|
|» description|body|string|false|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|» metadata|body|object \| null|false|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» supplier|body|object|true|The name and contact information for the supplier this billing profile represents|
|» » key|body|string|false|An optional unique key of the party (if available)|
|» » name|body|string|false|Legal name or representation of the organization.|
|» » taxId|body|object|false|The entity's legal ID code used for tax purposes. They may have<br>other numbers, but we're only interested in those valid for tax purposes.|
|» » » code|body|object|false|Normalized tax code shown on the original identity document.|
|» » addresses|body|[[Address](#schemaaddress)]|false|Regular post addresses for where information should be sent if needed.|
|» default|body|boolean|true|Is this the default profile?|
|» workflow|body|object|true|The billing workflow settings for this profile.|
|» » collection|body|object|false|The collection settings for this workflow|
|» » » alignment|body|object|false|The alignment for collecting the pending line items into an invoice.|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|[BillingWorkflowCollectionAlignmentSubscription](#schemabillingworkflowcollectionalignmentsubscription)|false|BillingWorkflowCollectionAlignmentSubscription specifies the alignment for collecting the pending line items<br>into an invoice.|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|[BillingWorkflowCollectionAlignmentAnchored](#schemabillingworkflowcollectionalignmentanchored)|false|BillingWorkflowCollectionAlignmentAnchored specifies the alignment for collecting the pending line items<br>into an invoice.|
|» » » interval|body|string(ISO8601)|false|This grace period can be used to delay the collection of the pending line items specified in<br>alignment.<br><br>This is useful, in case of multiple subscriptions having slightly different billing periods.|
|» » invoicing|body|object|false|The invoicing settings for this workflow|
|» » » autoAdvance|body|boolean|false|Whether to automatically issue the invoice after the draftPeriod has passed.|
|» » » draftPeriod|body|string(ISO8601)|false|The period for the invoice to be kept in draft status for manual reviews.|
|» » » dueAfter|body|string(ISO8601)|false|The period after which the invoice is due.<br>With some payment solutions it's only applicable for manual collection method.|
|» » » progressiveBilling|body|boolean|false|Should progressive billing be allowed for this workflow?|
|» » » subscriptionEndProrationMode|body|object|false|Controls how subscription-ending shortened service periods are billed.|
|» » » defaultTaxConfig|body|object|false|Default tax configuration to apply to the invoices.<br><br>Setting a tax code (`stripe.code` / `taxCodeId`) on a profile's default tax config is<br>deprecated and can no longer be added or changed: the organization default tax code is<br>used instead. Existing tax-code values may still be removed, and `behavior` remains<br>fully supported.|
|» » » » behavior|body|object|false|Tax behavior.<br><br>If not specified the billing profile is used to determine the tax behavior.<br>If not specified in the billing profile, the provider's default behavior is used.|
|» » » » stripe|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Stripe tax config.|
|» » » » » code|body|string|true|Product tax code.<br><br>See: https://docs.stripe.com/tax/tax-codes|
|» » » » customInvoicing|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Custom invoicing tax config.|
|» » » » » code|body|string|true|Tax code.<br><br>The tax code should be interpreted by the custom invoicing provider.|
|» » » » taxCodeId|body|string|false|Tax code reference.<br><br>When both `taxCodeId` and `stripe.code` are provided, `taxCodeId` takes precedence:<br>the referenced tax code entity is used and `stripe.code` is ignored.|
|» » payment|body|object|false|The payment settings for this workflow|
|» » » collectionMethod|body|object|false|The payment method for the invoice.|
|» » tax|body|object|false|The tax settings for this workflow|
|» » » enabled|body|boolean|false|Enable automatic tax calculation when tax is supported by the app.<br>For example, with Stripe Invoicing when enabled, tax is calculated via Stripe Tax.|
|» » » enforced|body|boolean|false|Enforce tax calculation when tax is supported by the app.<br>When enabled, OpenMeter will not allow to create an invoice without tax calculation.<br>Enforcement is different per apps, for example, Stripe app requires customer<br>to have a tax location when starting a paid subscription.|
|» apps|body|object|true|The apps used by this billing profile.|
|» » tax|body|string|true|The tax app used for this workflow|
|» » invoicing|body|string|true|The invoicing app used for this workflow|
|» » payment|body|string|true|The payment app used for this workflow|

## Get a billing profile

`GET /api/v1/billing/profiles/{id}`

Get a billing profile by id.

The expand option can be used to include additional information (besides the billing profile)
in the response. For example by adding the expand=apps option the apps used by the billing profile
will be included in the response.

<h3 id="get-a-billing-profile-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|none|
|expand|query|[[BillingProfileExpand](#schemabillingprofileexpand)]|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|expand|apps|

`PUT /api/v1/billing/profiles/{id}`

Update a billing profile by id.

The apps field cannot be updated directly, if an app change is desired a new
profile should be created.

> Body parameter

```json
  "workflow": {

      },
      "interval": "P1D"
    },
    "invoicing": {
      "autoAdvance": true,
      "draftPeriod": "P1D",
      "dueAfter": "P30D",
      "progressiveBilling": true,
      "subscriptionEndProrationMode": "bill_actual_period",
```

<h3 id="update-a-billing-profile-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[BillingProfileReplaceUpdateWithWorkflow](#schemabillingprofilereplaceupdatewithworkflow)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Human-readable name for the resource. Between 1 and 256 characters.|
|» description|body|string|false|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|» metadata|body|object \| null|false|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» supplier|body|object|true|The name and contact information for the supplier this billing profile represents|
|» » key|body|string|false|An optional unique key of the party (if available)|
|» » name|body|string|false|Legal name or representation of the organization.|
|» » taxId|body|object|false|The entity's legal ID code used for tax purposes. They may have<br>other numbers, but we're only interested in those valid for tax purposes.|
|» » » code|body|object|false|Normalized tax code shown on the original identity document.|
|» » addresses|body|[[Address](#schemaaddress)]|false|Regular post addresses for where information should be sent if needed.|
|» default|body|boolean|true|Is this the default profile?|
|» workflow|body|object|true|The billing workflow settings for this profile.|
|» » collection|body|object|false|The collection settings for this workflow|
|» » » alignment|body|object|false|The alignment for collecting the pending line items into an invoice.|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|[BillingWorkflowCollectionAlignmentSubscription](#schemabillingworkflowcollectionalignmentsubscription)|false|BillingWorkflowCollectionAlignmentSubscription specifies the alignment for collecting the pending line items<br>into an invoice.|
|» » » » *oneOf*|body|[BillingWorkflowCollectionAlignmentAnchored](#schemabillingworkflowcollectionalignmentanchored)|false|BillingWorkflowCollectionAlignmentAnchored specifies the alignment for collecting the pending line items<br>into an invoice.|
|» » » interval|body|string(ISO8601)|false|This grace period can be used to delay the collection of the pending line items specified in<br>alignment.<br><br>This is useful, in case of multiple subscriptions having slightly different billing periods.|
|» » invoicing|body|object|false|The invoicing settings for this workflow|
|» » » autoAdvance|body|boolean|false|Whether to automatically issue the invoice after the draftPeriod has passed.|
|» » » draftPeriod|body|string(ISO8601)|false|The period for the invoice to be kept in draft status for manual reviews.|
|» » » dueAfter|body|string(ISO8601)|false|The period after which the invoice is due.<br>With some payment solutions it's only applicable for manual collection method.|
|» » » progressiveBilling|body|boolean|false|Should progressive billing be allowed for this workflow?|
|» » » subscriptionEndProrationMode|body|object|false|Controls how subscription-ending shortened service periods are billed.|
|» » » defaultTaxConfig|body|object|false|Default tax configuration to apply to the invoices.<br><br>Setting a tax code (`stripe.code` / `taxCodeId`) on a profile's default tax config is<br>deprecated and can no longer be added or changed: the organization default tax code is<br>used instead. Existing tax-code values may still be removed, and `behavior` remains<br>fully supported.|
|» » » » behavior|body|object|false|Tax behavior.<br><br>If not specified the billing profile is used to determine the tax behavior.<br>If not specified in the billing profile, the provider's default behavior is used.|
|» » » » stripe|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Stripe tax config.|
|» » » » » code|body|string|true|Product tax code.<br><br>See: https://docs.stripe.com/tax/tax-codes|
|» » » » customInvoicing|body|object|false|**Deprecated.** Custom invoicing tax config.|
|» » » » » code|body|string|true|Tax code.<br><br>The tax code should be interpreted by the custom invoicing provider.|
|» » » » taxCodeId|body|string|false|Tax code reference.<br><br>When both `taxCodeId` and `stripe.code` are provided, `taxCodeId` takes precedence:<br>the referenced tax code entity is used and `stripe.code` is ignored.|
|» » payment|body|object|false|The payment settings for this workflow|
|» » » collectionMethod|body|object|false|The payment method for the invoice.|
|» » tax|body|object|false|The tax settings for this workflow|
|» » » enabled|body|boolean|false|Enable automatic tax calculation when tax is supported by the app.<br>For example, with Stripe Invoicing when enabled, tax is calculated via Stripe Tax.|
|» » » enforced|body|boolean|false|Enforce tax calculation when tax is supported by the app.<br>When enabled, OpenMeter will not allow to create an invoice without tax calculation.<br>Enforcement is different per apps, for example, Stripe app requires customer<br>to have a tax location when starting a paid subscription.|

## Delete a billing profile

<a id="opIddeleteBillingProfile"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/billing/profiles/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/problem+json'
```

`DELETE /api/v1/billing/profiles/{id}`

Delete a billing profile by id.

Only such billing profiles can be deleted that are:
- not the default one
- not pinned to any customer using customer overrides
- only have finalized invoices

<h3 id="delete-a-billing-profile-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|none|

<h1 id="openmeter-api-app-custom-invoicing">App: Custom Invoicing</h1>

Interface third party invoicing and payment systems.

## Submit draft synchronization results

<a id="opIdappCustomInvoicingDraftSynchronized"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/apps/custom-invoicing/01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH/draft/synchronized \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/problem+json' \
  -d '{
    "invoicing": {
      "invoiceNumber": {},
      "externalId": "string",
      "lineExternalIds": [
        {
          "lineId": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH",
          "externalId": "string"
        }
      ],
      "lineDiscountExternalIds": [
        {
          "lineDiscountId": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH",
          "externalId": "string"
        }
      ]
    }
  }'
```

`POST /api/v1/apps/custom-invoicing/{invoiceId}/draft/synchronized`

> Body parameter

```json
    "invoiceNumber": {},
    "externalId": "string",

        "lineId": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH",
        "externalId": "string"
      }
```

## Create checkout session

<a id="opIdcreateStripeCheckoutSession"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://openmeter.cloud/api/v1/stripe/checkout/sessions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "customer": {
      "name": "ACME, Inc.",
      "currency": "USD",
      "usageAttribution": {
        "subjectKeys": [
          "my-identifier"
        ]
      }
    },
    "options": {
      "currency": "USD",
      "successURL": "http://example.com",
      "billingAddressCollection": "required",
      "taxIdCollection": {
        "enabled": true,
        "required": "if_supported"
      },
      "customerUpdate": {
        "name": "auto",
        "address": "auto"
      }
    }
  }'
```

`POST /api/v1/stripe/checkout/sessions`

Create checkout session.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "customer": {
    "name": "ACME, Inc.",
    "currency": "USD",
    "usageAttribution": {
      "subjectKeys": [
        "my-identifier"
      ]
    }
  },
  "options": {
    "currency": "USD",
    "successURL": "http://example.com",
    "billingAddressCollection": "required",
    "taxIdCollection": {
      "enabled": true,
      "required": "if_supported"
    },
    "customerUpdate": {
      "name": "auto",
      "address": "auto"
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-checkout-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[CreateStripeCheckoutSessionRequest](#schemacreatestripecheckoutsessionrequest)|true|none|
|» appId|body|string|false|If not provided, the default Stripe app is used if any.|
|» customer|body|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid) \| [CustomerKey](#schemacustomerkey) \| [CustomerCreate](#schemacustomercreate)|true|Provide a customer ID or key to use an existing OpenMeter customer.<br>or provide a customer object to create a new customer.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid)|false|Create Stripe checkout session with customer ID.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[CustomerKey](#schemacustomerkey)|false|Create Stripe checkout session with customer key.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|[CustomerCreate](#schemacustomercreate)|false|Resource create operation model.|
|» stripeCustomerId|body|string|false|Stripe customer ID.<br>If not provided OpenMeter creates a new Stripe customer or<br>uses the OpenMeter customer's default Stripe customer ID.|
|» options|body|object|true|Options passed to Stripe when creating the checkout session.|
|» » billingAddressCollection|body|object|false|Specify whether Checkout should collect the customer’s billing address. Defaults to auto.|
|» » cancelURL|body|string|false|If set, Checkout displays a back button and customers will be directed to this URL if they decide to cancel payment and return to your website.<br>This parameter is not allowed if ui_mode is embedded.|
|» » clientReferenceID|body|string|false|A unique string to reference the Checkout Session. This can be a customer ID, a cart ID, or similar, and can be used to reconcile the session with your internal systems.|
|» » customerUpdate|body|object|false|Controls what fields on Customer can be updated by the Checkout Session.|
|» » » address|body|object|false|Describes whether Checkout saves the billing address onto customer.address.<br>To always collect a full billing address, use billing_address_collection.<br>Defaults to never.|
|» » » name|body|object|false|Describes whether Checkout saves the name onto customer.name.<br>Defaults to never.|
|» » » shipping|body|object|false|Describes whether Checkout saves shipping information onto customer.shipping.<br>To collect shipping information, use shipping_address_collection.<br>Defaults to never.|
|» » consentCollection|body|object|false|Configure fields for the Checkout Session to gather active consent from customers.|
|» » » paymentMethodReuseAgreement|body|object|false|Determines the position and visibility of the payment method reuse agreement in the UI.<br>When set to auto, Stripe’s defaults will be used. When set to hidden, the payment method reuse agreement text will always be hidden in the UI.|
|» » » » position|body|[CreateStripeCheckoutSessionConsentCollectionPaymentMethodReuseAgreementPosition](#schemacreatestripecheckoutsessionconsentcollectionpaymentmethodreuseagreementposition)|false|Create Stripe checkout session consent collection agreement position.|
|» » » promotions|body|object|false|If set to auto, enables the collection of customer consent for promotional communications.<br>The Checkout Session will determine whether to display an option to opt into promotional<br>communication from the merchant depending on the customer’s locale. Only available to US merchants.|
|» » » termsOfService|body|object|false|If set to required, it requires customers to check a terms of service checkbox before being able to pay.<br>There must be a valid terms of service URL set in your Stripe Dashboard settings.<br>https://dashboard.stripe.com/settings/public|
|» » currency|body|object|false|Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.|
|» » customText|body|object|false|Display additional text for your customers using custom text.|
|» » » afterSubmit|body|object|false|Custom text that should be displayed after the payment confirmation button.|
|» » » » message|body|string|false|none|
|» » » shippingAddress|body|object|false|Custom text that should be displayed alongside shipping address collection.|
|» » » » message|body|string|false|none|

|» » » » message|body|string|false|none|
|» » » termsOfServiceAcceptance|body|object|false|Custom text that should be displayed in place of the default terms of service agreement text.|
|» » » » message|body|string|false|none|
|» » expiresAt|body|integer(int64)|false|The Epoch time in seconds at which the Checkout Session will expire.<br>It can be anywhere from 30 minutes to 24 hours after Checkout Session creation. By default, this value is 24 hours from creation.|

`POST /api/v1/marketplace/listings/{type}/install`

```json
}
```

<h3 id="install-app-via-oauth2-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|303|See Other|Redirection|None|
|400|Bad Request|The server cannot or will not process the request due to something that is perceived to be a client error (e.g., malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing, or deceptive request routing).|[BadRequestProblemResponse](#schemabadrequestproblemresponse)|
|401|Unauthorized|The request has not been applied because it lacks valid authentication credentials for the target resource.|[UnauthorizedProblemResponse](#schemaunauthorizedproblemresponse)|
|403|Forbidden|The server understood the request but refuses to authorize it.|[ForbiddenProblemResponse](#schemaforbiddenproblemresponse)|
|412|Precondition Failed|One or more conditions given in the request header fields evaluated to false when tested on the server.|[PreconditionFailedProblemResponse](#schemapreconditionfailedproblemresponse)|
|500|Internal Server Error|The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.|[InternalServerErrorProblemResponse](#schemainternalservererrorproblemresponse)|
|503|Service Unavailable|The server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance, which will likely be alleviated after some delay.|[ServiceUnavailableProblemResponse](#schemaserviceunavailableproblemresponse)|
|default|Default|An unexpected error response.|[UnexpectedProblemResponse](#schemaunexpectedproblemresponse)|

This operation does not require authentication

|---|---|---|---|---|

|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was last updated.|
|deletedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was permanently deleted.|
|key|string|true|none|A semi-unique identifier for the resource.|
|annotations|object|false|read-only|Set of key-value pairs managed by the system. Cannot be modified by user.|

|currency|object|true|none|The currency code of the add-on.|
|effectiveFrom|string(date-time)|false|read-only|The date and time when the add-on becomes effective. When not specified, the add-on is a draft.|
|effectiveTo|string(date-time)|false|read-only|The date and time when the add-on is no longer effective. When not specified, the add-on is effective indefinitely.|
|status|object|true|read-only|The status of the add-on.<br>Computed based on the effective start and end dates:<br>- draft = no effectiveFrom<br>- active = effectiveFrom <= now < effectiveTo<br>- archived  = effectiveTo <= now|

|validationErrors|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|true|read-only|List of validation errors.|

```json
{
  "type": "about:blank",
  "title": "Bad Request",
  "status": 400,
  "detail": "The request body must be a JSON object.",
  "instance": "urn:request:local/JMOlctsKV8-000001",
  "extensions": {
    "validationErrors": [
      {
        "code": "validation_error",
        "message": "Validation error"
      }
    ],
    "otherAttribute": "otherValue"
  },
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

The server cannot or will not process the request due to something that is perceived to be a client error (e.g., malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing, or deceptive request routing).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string(uri)|true|none|Type contains a URI that identifies the problem type.|
|title|string|true|none|A a short, human-readable summary of the problem type.|
|status|integer(int16)|false|none|The HTTP status code generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.|
|detail|string|true|none|A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.|
|instance|string(uri)|true|none|A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.|
|extensions|object|false|none|Additional properties specific to the problem type may be present.|
|**additionalProperties**|object|false|none|none|

```json
  },
```
```json
  "addresses": [
```

BillingInvoiceCustomerExtendedDetails is a collection of fields that are used to extend the billing party details for invoices.

These fields contain the OpenMeter specific details for the customer, that are not strictly required for the invoice itself.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|read-only|Unique identifier for the party (if available)|
|key|string|false|none|An optional unique key of the party (if available)|
|name|string|false|none|Legal name or representation of the organization.|
|taxId|object|false|none|The entity's legal ID code used for tax purposes. They may have<br>other numbers, but we're only interested in those valid for tax purposes.|
|addresses|[[Address](#schemaaddress)]|false|none|Regular post addresses for where information should be sent if needed.|
|usageAttribution|object|true|none|Mapping to attribute metered usage to the customer|

BillingProfile represents a billing profile

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|read-only|A unique identifier for the resource.|
|name|string|true|none|Human-readable name for the resource. Between 1 and 256 characters.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was last updated.|
|deletedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was permanently deleted.|
|supplier|object|true|none|The name and contact information for the supplier this billing profile represents|
|workflow|object|true|read-only|The billing workflow settings for this profile|
|apps|object|true|read-only|The applications used by this billing profile.<br><br>Expand settings govern if this includes the whole app object or just the ID references.|
|default|boolean|true|none|Is this the default profile?|
