Customer specific workflow overrides.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customerOverride|object|false|none|The customer override values.<br><br>If empty the merged values are calculated based on the default profile.|
|baseBillingProfileId|string|true|none|The billing profile the customerProfile is associated with at the time of query.<br><br>customerOverride contains the explicit mapping set in the customer override object. If that is<br>empty, then the baseBillingProfileId is the default profile.|
|customerProfile|object|false|none|Merged billing profile with the customer specific overrides.|
|customer|object|false|none|The customer this override belongs to.|

<h2 id="tocS_BillingSettlementMode">BillingSettlementMode</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabillingsettlementmode"></a>
<a id="schema_BillingSettlementMode"></a>
<a id="tocSbillingsettlementmode"></a>
<a id="tocsbillingsettlementmode"></a>

```json
"credit_then_invoice"
```

The settlement mode of a plan.
It determines how the billing system generates invoices and credits for the subscriptions using this plan.
- credit_then_invoice: credits from the previous billing period are applied first, then the remaining balance is invoiced. This is the default and most common settlement mode.
- credit_only: only credits from the previous billing period are generated and applied. No invoices are generated for the subscription.

```json
{
  "address": {},
  "name": {},

}
```

Controls what fields on Customer can be updated by the Checkout Session.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address|object|false|none|Describes whether Checkout saves the billing address onto customer.address.<br>To always collect a full billing address, use billing_address_collection.<br>Defaults to never.|
|name|object|false|none|Describes whether Checkout saves the name onto customer.name.<br>Defaults to never.|
|shipping|object|false|none|Describes whether Checkout saves shipping information onto customer.shipping.<br>To collect shipping information, use shipping_address_collection.<br>Defaults to never.|

```json
{
  "customer": {
    "name": "ACME, Inc.",
    "currency": "USD",
    "usageAttribution": {
      "subjectKeys": [
        "my-identifier"
      ]
    }
  },
  "options": {
    "currency": "USD",
    "successURL": "http://example.com",
    "billingAddressCollection": "required",
    "taxIdCollection": {
      "enabled": true,
      "required": "if_supported"
    },
    "customerUpdate": {
      "name": "auto",
      "address": "auto"
    }
  }
}
```

Create Stripe checkout session request.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|appId|string|false|none|If not provided, the default Stripe app is used if any.|
|customer|[CustomerId](#schemacustomerid) \| [CustomerKey](#schemacustomerkey) \| [CustomerCreate](#schemacustomercreate)|true|none|Provide a customer ID or key to use an existing OpenMeter customer.<br>or provide a customer object to create a new customer.|
|stripeCustomerId|string|false|none|Stripe customer ID.<br>If not provided OpenMeter creates a new Stripe customer or<br>uses the OpenMeter customer's default Stripe customer ID.|
|options|object|true|none|Options passed to Stripe when creating the checkout session.|

<h2 id="tocS_CreateStripeCheckoutSessionRequestOptions">CreateStripeCheckoutSessionRequestOptions</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacreatestripecheckoutsessionrequestoptions"></a>
<a id="schema_CreateStripeCheckoutSessionRequestOptions"></a>
<a id="tocScreatestripecheckoutsessionrequestoptions"></a>
<a id="tocscreatestripecheckoutsessionrequestoptions"></a>

```json
{
  "billingAddressCollection": {},
  "cancelURL": "string",
  "clientReferenceID": "string",
  "customerUpdate": {
    "address": {},
    "name": {},
    "shipping": {}
  },
  "consentCollection": {
    "paymentMethodReuseAgreement": {
      "position": "auto"
    },
    "promotions": {},
    "termsOfService": {}
  },
  "currency": {},
  "customText": {
    "afterSubmit": {
      "message": "string"
    },
    "shippingAddress": {
      "message": "string"
    },
    "submit": {
      "message": "string"
    },
    "termsOfServiceAcceptance": {
      "message": "string"
    }
  },
  "expiresAt": 0,
  "locale": "string",
  "metadata": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  },
  "returnURL": "string",
  "successURL": "string",
  "uiMode": {},
  "paymentMethodTypes": [
    "string"
  ],
  "redirectOnCompletion": {},
  "taxIdCollection": {
    "enabled": true,
    "required": {}
  }
}
```

Create Stripe checkout session options
See https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|billingAddressCollection|object|false|none|Specify whether Checkout should collect the customer’s billing address. Defaults to auto.|
|cancelURL|string|false|none|If set, Checkout displays a back button and customers will be directed to this URL if they decide to cancel payment and return to your website.<br>This parameter is not allowed if ui_mode is embedded.|
|clientReferenceID|string|false|none|A unique string to reference the Checkout Session. This can be a customer ID, a cart ID, or similar, and can be used to reconcile the session with your internal systems.|
|customerUpdate|object|false|none|Controls what fields on Customer can be updated by the Checkout Session.|
|consentCollection|object|false|none|Configure fields for the Checkout Session to gather active consent from customers.|
|currency|object|false|none|Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.|
|customText|object|false|none|Display additional text for your customers using custom text.|
|expiresAt|integer(int64)|false|none|The Epoch time in seconds at which the Checkout Session will expire.<br>It can be anywhere from 30 minutes to 24 hours after Checkout Session creation. By default, this value is 24 hours from creation.|
|locale|string|false|none|none|
|metadata|object|false|none|Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.<br>This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.<br>Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them.<br>All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.|
|returnURL|string|false|none|The URL to redirect your customer back to after they authenticate or cancel their payment on the payment method’s app or site.<br>This parameter is required if ui_mode is embedded and redirect-based payment methods are enabled on the session.|
|successURL|string|false|none|The URL to which Stripe should send customers when payment or setup is complete.<br>This parameter is not allowed if ui_mode is embedded.<br>If you’d like to use information from the successful Checkout Session on your page, read the guide on customizing your success page:<br>https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/custom-success-page|
|uiMode|object|false|none|The UI mode of the Session. Defaults to hosted.|
|paymentMethodTypes|[string]|false|none|A list of the types of payment methods (e.g., card) this Checkout Session can accept.|
|redirectOnCompletion|object|false|none|This parameter applies to ui_mode: embedded. Defaults to always.<br>Learn more about the redirect behavior of embedded sessions at<br>https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/custom-success-page?payment-ui=embedded-form|
|taxIdCollection|object|false|none|Controls tax ID collection during checkout.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customerId|string|true|none|The OpenMeter customer ID.|
|stripeCustomerId|string|true|none|The Stripe customer ID.|
|sessionId|string|true|none|The checkout session ID.|
|setupIntentId|string|true|none|The checkout session setup intent ID.|
|clientSecret|string|false|none|The client secret of the checkout session.<br>This can be used to initialize Stripe.js for your client-side implementation.|

|currency|object|false|none|Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp at which the checkout session was created.|
|expiresAt|string(date-time)|false|none|Timestamp at which the checkout session will expire.|
|metadata|object|false|none|Set of key-value pairs attached to the checkout session.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the checkout session.|
|url|string|false|none|URL to show the checkout session.|
|mode|object|true|none|Mode<br>Always `setup` for now.|
|cancelURL|string|false|none|Cancel URL.|
|successURL|string|false|none|Success URL.|

```json
{
  "id": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH",
  "name": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "metadata": {
    "externalId": "019142cc-a016-796a-8113-1a942fecd26d"
  },
  "createdAt": "2024-01-01T01:01:01.001Z",
  "updatedAt": "2024-01-01T01:01:01.001Z",
  "deletedAt": "2024-01-01T01:01:01.001Z",
  "listing": {
    "type": "stripe",
    "name": "Stripe",
    "description": "Stripe integration allows you to collect payments with Stripe.",
    "capabilities": [
      {
        "type": "calculateTax",
        "key": "stripe_calculate_tax",
        "name": "Calculate Tax",
        "description": "Stripe Tax calculates tax portion of the invoices."
      },
      {
        "type": "invoiceCustomers",
        "key": "stripe_invoice_customers",
        "name": "Invoice Customers",
        "description": "Stripe invoices customers with due amount."
      },
      {
        "type": "collectPayments",
        "key": "stripe_collect_payments",
        "name": "Collect Payments",
        "description": "Stripe payments collects outstanding revenue with Stripe customer's default payment method."
      }
    ],
    "installMethods": [
      "with_oauth2",
      "with_api_key"
    ]
  },
  "status": {},
  "type": "custom_invoicing",
  "enableDraftSyncHook": true,
  "enableIssuingSyncHook": true
}
```

Custom Invoicing app can be used for interface with any invoicing or payment system.

This app provides ways to manipulate invoices and payments, however the integration
must rely on Notifications API to get notified about invoice changes.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|read-only|A unique identifier for the resource.|
|name|string|true|none|Human-readable name for the resource. Between 1 and 256 characters.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was last updated.|
|deletedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was permanently deleted.|
|listing|object|true|read-only|The marketplace listing that this installed app is based on.|
|status|object|true|read-only|Status of the app connection.|
|type|string|true|none|The app's type is CustomInvoicing.|
|enableDraftSyncHook|boolean|true|none|Enable draft.sync hook.<br><br>If the hook is not enabled, the invoice will be progressed to the next state automatically.|
|enableIssuingSyncHook|boolean|true|none|Enable issuing.sync hook.<br><br>If the hook is not enabled, the invoice will be progressed to the next state automatically.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|custom_invoicing|

Plan input for custom subscription creation (without key and version).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|Human-readable name for the resource. Between 1 and 256 characters.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|alignment|object|false|none|Alignment configuration for the plan.|
|currency|object|true|none|The currency code of the plan.|
|billingCadence|string(duration)|true|none|The default billing cadence for subscriptions using this plan.<br>Defines how often customers are billed using ISO8601 duration format.<br>Examples: "P1M" (monthly), "P3M" (quarterly), "P1Y" (annually).|
|proRatingConfig|object|false|none|Default pro-rating configuration for subscriptions using this plan.|
|settlementMode|object|false|none|The settlement mode of the plan.<br>It determines how the billing system generates invoices and credits for the subscriptions using this plan.<br>- credit_then_invoice: credits from the previous billing period are applied first, then the remaining balance is invoiced.<br>- credit_only: only credits from the previous billing period are generated and applied. No invoices are generated for the subscription.<br>This is the default and most common settlement mode.|
|phases|[[PlanPhase](#schemaplanphase)]|true|none|The plan phase or pricing ramp allows changing a plan's rate cards over time as a subscription progresses.<br>A phase switch occurs only at the end of a billing period, ensuring that a single subscription invoice will not include charges from different phase prices.|


A customer object.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|read-only|A unique identifier for the resource.|
|name|string|true|none|Human-readable name for the resource. Between 1 and 256 characters.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was last updated.|
|deletedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was permanently deleted.|
|key|string|false|none|An optional unique key of the customer.<br>Either key or usageAttribution.subjectKeys must be provided.<br>Useful to reference the customer in external systems.<br>For example, your database ID.|
|usageAttribution|object|false|none|Mapping to attribute metered usage to the customer<br>Either key or usageAttribution.subjectKeys must be provided.|
|primaryEmail|string|false|none|The primary email address of the customer.|
|currency|object|false|none|Currency of the customer.<br>Used for billing, tax and invoicing.|
|billingAddress|object|false|none|The billing address of the customer.<br>Used for tax and invoicing.|
|currentSubscriptionId|string|false|read-only|The ID of the Subscription if the customer has one.|
|subscriptions|[[Subscription](#schemasubscription)]|false|read-only|The subscriptions of the customer.<br>Only with the `subscriptions` expand option.|
|annotations|object|false|read-only|Set of key-value pairs managed by the system. Cannot be modified by user.|

Metered entitlements are useful for many different use cases, from setting up usage based access to implementing complex credit systems.
Access is determined based on feature usage using a balance calculation (the "usage allowance" provided by the issued grants is "burnt down" by the usage).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|none|
|isSoftLimit|boolean|false|none|If softLimit=true the subject can use the feature even if the entitlement is exhausted, hasAccess will always be true.|
|isUnlimited|boolean|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated, ignored by the backend. Please use isSoftLimit instead; this field will be removed in the future.|
|issueAfterReset|number(double)|false|none|You can grant usage automatically alongside the entitlement, the example scenario would be creating a starting balance.<br>If an amount is specified here, a grant will be created alongside the entitlement with the specified amount.<br>That grant will have it's rollover settings configured in a way that after each reset operation, the balance will return the original amount specified here.<br>Manually creating such a grant would mean having the "amount", "minRolloverAmount", and "maxRolloverAmount" fields all be the same.|
|issueAfterResetPriority|integer(uint8)|false|none|Defines the grant priority for the default grant.|
|preserveOverageAtReset|boolean|false|none|If true, the overage is preserved at reset. If false, the usage is reset to 0.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was last updated.|
|deletedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was permanently deleted.|
|metadata|object|false|none|Additional metadata for the feature.|
|activeFrom|string(date-time)|true|none|The cadence start of the resource.|
|activeTo|string(date-time)|false|none|The cadence end of the resource.|
|annotations|object|false|read-only|The annotations of the entitlement.|
|id|string|true|read-only|Readonly unique ULID identifier.|
|subjectKey|string|true|none|The identifier key unique to the subject.<br>NOTE: Subjects are being deprecated, please use the new customer APIs.|
|featureKey|string|true|none|The feature the subject is entitled to use.|
|featureId|string|true|none|The feature the subject is entitled to use.|
|lastReset|string(date-time)|true|read-only|The time the last reset happened.|
|currentUsagePeriod|object|true|read-only|The current usage period.|
|measureUsageFrom|string(date-time)|true|read-only|The time from which usage is measured. If not specified on creation, defaults to entitlement creation time.|
|usagePeriod|object|true|read-only|THe usage period of the entitlement.|

|---|---|---|---|---|
|featureKey|string|false|none|The feature the subject is entitled to use.<br>Either featureKey or featureId is required.|
|featureId|string|false|none|The feature the subject is entitled to use.<br>Either featureKey or featureId is required.|
|metadata|object|false|none|Additional metadata for the feature.|
|type|string|true|none|none|
|isSoftLimit|boolean|false|none|If softLimit=true the subject can use the feature even if the entitlement is exhausted, hasAccess will always be true.|
|isUnlimited|boolean|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated, ignored by the backend. Please use isSoftLimit instead; this field will be removed in the future.|
|usagePeriod|object|true|none|The usage period associated with the entitlement.|
|measureUsageFrom|object|false|none|Defines the time from which usage is measured. If not specified on creation, defaults to entitlement creation time.|
|issueAfterReset|number(double)|false|none|You can grant usage automatically alongside the entitlement, the example scenario would be creating a starting balance.<br>If an amount is specified here, a grant will be created alongside the entitlement with the specified amount.<br>That grant will have it's rollover settings configured in a way that after each reset operation, the balance will return the original amount specified here.<br>Manually creating such a grant would mean having the "amount", "minRolloverAmount", and "maxRolloverAmount" fields all be the same.|
|issueAfterResetPriority|integer(uint8)|false|none|Defines the grant priority for the default grant.|
|preserveOverageAtReset|boolean|false|none|If true, the overage is preserved at reset. If false, the usage is reset to 0.|

Metered entitlements are useful for many different use cases, from setting up usage based access to implementing complex credit systems.
Access is determined based on feature usage using a balance calculation (the "usage allowance" provided by the issued grants is "burnt down" by the usage).

<h2 id="tocS_EntitlementValue">EntitlementValue</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaentitlementvalue"></a>
<a id="schema_EntitlementValue"></a>
<a id="tocSentitlementvalue"></a>
<a id="tocsentitlementvalue"></a>

```json
{
  "hasAccess": true,
  "balance": 100,
  "usage": 50,
  "overage": 0,
  "totalAvailableGrantAmount": 100,
  "config": "{ key: \"value\" }"
}
```

Entitlements are the core of OpenMeter access management. They define access to features for subjects. Entitlements can be metered, boolean, or static.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|hasAccess|boolean|true|read-only|Whether the subject has access to the feature. Shared accross all entitlement types.|
|balance|number(double)|false|read-only|Only available for metered entitlements. Metered entitlements are built around a balance calculation where feature usage is deducted from the issued grants. Balance represents the remaining balance of the entitlement, it's value never turns negative.|
|usage|number(double)|false|read-only|Only available for metered entitlements. Returns the total feature usage in the current period.|
|overage|number(double)|false|read-only|Only available for metered entitlements. Overage represents the usage that wasn't covered by grants, e.g. if the subject had a total feature usage of 100 in the period but they were only granted 80, there would be 20 overage.|
|totalAvailableGrantAmount|number(double)|false|read-only|Only available for metered entitlements. The summed amount of all grant active at query time PLUS the used amount of since inactive grants.|
|config|string|false|read-only|Only available for static entitlements. The JSON parsable config of the entitlement.|

<h2 id="tocS_EntitlementValueV2">EntitlementValueV2</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaentitlementvaluev2"></a>
<a id="schema_EntitlementValueV2"></a>
<a id="tocSentitlementvaluev2"></a>
<a id="tocsentitlementvaluev2"></a>

```json
{
  "hasAccess": true,
  "balance": 100,
  "usage": 50,
  "overage": 0,
  "totalAvailableGrantAmount": 100,
  "config": "{ key: \"value\" }",
  "grantBalances": {
    "property1": 0,
    "property2": 0
  }
}
```

EntitlementValueV2 returns entitlement access state and value fields for customer-scoped V2 APIs.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|hasAccess|boolean|true|read-only|Whether the subject has access to the feature. Shared accross all entitlement types.|
|balance|number(double)|false|read-only|Only available for metered entitlements. Metered entitlements are built around a balance calculation where feature usage is deducted from the issued grants. Balance represents the remaining balance of the entitlement, it's value never turns negative.|
|usage|number(double)|false|read-only|Only available for metered entitlements. Returns the total feature usage in the current period.|
|overage|number(double)|false|read-only|Only available for metered entitlements. Overage represents the usage that wasn't covered by grants, e.g. if the subject had a total feature usage of 100 in the period but they were only granted 80, there would be 20 overage.|
|totalAvailableGrantAmount|number(double)|false|read-only|Only available for metered entitlements. The summed amount of all grant active at query time PLUS the used amount of since inactive grants.|
|config|string|false|read-only|Only available for static entitlements. The JSON parsable config of the entitlement.|
|grantBalances|object|false|read-only|Only available for metered entitlements. The closing balance of each active grant at query time.<br>The key is the grant ID and the value is the remaining balance.|

```json
    "inputPerToken": {},
    "outputPerToken": {},
    "cacheReadPerToken": {},
    "reasoningPerToken": {},
    "cacheWritePerToken": {}
  }
}
```

LLM cost lookup configuration.
Maps meter group-by dimensions to LLM cost database fields.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|none|
|providerProperty|string|false|none|Meter group-by property that holds the LLM provider.<br>Use this when the meter has a group-by dimension for provider.<br>Mutually exclusive with `provider`.|
|provider|string|false|none|Static LLM provider value (e.g., "openai", "anthropic").<br>Use this when the feature tracks a single provider.<br>Mutually exclusive with `providerProperty`.|
|modelProperty|string|false|none|Meter group-by property that holds the model ID.<br>Use this when the meter has a group-by dimension for model.<br>Mutually exclusive with `model`.|
|model|string|false|none|Static model ID value (e.g., "gpt-4", "claude-3-5-sonnet").<br>Use this when the feature tracks a single model.<br>Mutually exclusive with `modelProperty`.|
|tokenTypeProperty|string|false|none|Meter group-by property that holds the token type.<br>Use this when the meter has a group-by dimension for token type.<br>Mutually exclusive with `tokenType`.|
|tokenType|string|false|none|Static token type value.<br>Use this when the feature tracks a single token type (e.g., only input tokens).<br>Expected values: input, output, cache_read, reasoning, cache_write, request, response.<br>`request` is an alias for `input`, `response` is an alias for `output`.<br>Mutually exclusive with `tokenTypeProperty`.|
|pricing|object|false|read-only|Resolved per-token pricing from the LLM cost database.<br>Only populated in responses when the feature's meter group-by filters<br>specify exact provider and model values.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|llm|

Invoice represents an invoice in the system.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|read-only|A unique identifier for the resource.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was last updated.|
|deletedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was permanently deleted.|
|type|object|true|read-only|Type of the invoice.<br><br>The type of invoice determines the purpose of the invoice and how it should be handled.<br><br>Supported types:<br>- standard: A regular commercial invoice document between a supplier and customer.<br>- credit_note: Reflects a refund either partial or complete of the preceding document. A credit note effectively *extends* the previous document.|
|supplier|object|true|none|The taxable entity supplying the goods or services.|
|customer|object|true|none|Legal entity receiving the goods or services.|
|number|object|true|read-only|Number specifies the human readable key used to reference this Invoice.<br><br>The invoice number can change in the draft phases, as we are allocating temporary draft<br>invoice numbers, but it's final as soon as the invoice gets finalized (issued state).<br><br>Please note that the number is (depending on the upstream settings) either unique for the<br>whole organization or unique for the customer, or in multi (stripe) account setups unique for the<br>account.|
|currency|object|true|none|Currency for all invoice line items.<br><br>Multi currency invoices are not supported yet.|
|preceding|[[InvoiceDocumentRef](#schemainvoicedocumentref)]|false|read-only|Key information regarding previous invoices and potentially details as to why they were corrected.|
|totals|object|true|read-only|Summary of all the invoice totals, including taxes (calculated).|
|status|object|true|read-only|The status of the invoice.<br><br>This field only conatins a simplified status, for more detailed information use the statusDetails field.|
|statusDetails|object|true|read-only|The details of the current invoice status.|
|issuedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|The time the invoice was issued.<br><br>Depending on the status of the invoice this can mean multiple things:<br>- draft, gathering: The time the invoice will be issued based on the workflow settings.<br>- issued: The time the invoice was issued.|
|draftUntil|string(date-time)|false|none|The time until the invoice is in draft status.<br><br>On draft invoice creation it is calculated from the workflow settings.<br><br>If manual approval is required, the draftUntil time is set.|
|quantitySnapshotedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|The time when the quantity snapshots on the invoice lines were taken.|
|collectionAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|The time when the invoice will be/has been collected.|
|dueAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|Due time of the fulfillment of the invoice (if available).|
|period|object|false|none|The period the invoice covers. If the invoice has no line items, it's not set.|
|voidedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|The time the invoice was voided.<br><br>If the invoice was voided, this field will be set to the time the invoice was voided.|
|sentToCustomerAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|The time the invoice was sent to customer.|
|workflow|object|true|none|The workflow associated with the invoice.<br><br>It is always a snapshot of the workflow settings at the time of invoice creation. The<br>field is optional as it should be explicitly requested with expand options.|
|lines|[[InvoiceLine](#schemainvoiceline)]|false|none|List of invoice lines representing each of the items sold to the customer.|
|payment|object|false|read-only|Information on when, how, and to whom the invoice should be paid.|
|validationIssues|[[ValidationIssue](#schemavalidationissue)]|false|read-only|Validation issues reported by the invoice workflow.|
|externalIds|object|false|read-only|External IDs of the invoice in other apps such as Stripe.|

InvoiceAppExternalIds contains the external IDs of the invoice in other apps such as Stripe.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoicing|string|false|read-only|The external ID of the invoice in the invoicing app if available.|
|tax|string|false|read-only|The external ID of the invoice in the tax app if available.|
|payment|string|false|read-only|The external ID of the invoice in the payment app if available.|

InvoiceAvailableActionInvoiceDetails represents the details of the invoice action for
non-gathering invoices.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|resultingState|string|true|read-only|The state the invoice will reach if the action is activated and<br>all intermediate steps are successful.<br><br>For example advancing a draft_created invoice will result in a draft_manual_approval_needed invoice.|

InvoiceAvailableActions represents the actions that can be performed on the invoice.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|advance|object|false|read-only|Advance the invoice to the next status.|
|approve|object|false|read-only|Approve an invoice that requires manual approval.|
|delete|object|false|read-only|Delete the invoice (only non-issued invoices can be deleted).|
|retry|object|false|read-only|Retry an invoice issuing step that failed.|
|snapshotQuantities|object|false|read-only|Snapshot quantities for usage based line items.|
|void|object|false|read-only|Void an already issued invoice.|
|invoice|object|false|read-only|Invoice a gathering invoice|

InvoiceDetailedLine represents a line item that is sold to the customer as a manually added fee.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|Human-readable name for the resource. Between 1 and 256 characters.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was last updated.|
|deletedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was permanently deleted.|
|id|string|true|none|ID of the line.|
|managedBy|object|true|read-only|managedBy specifies if the line is manually added via the api or managed by OpenMeter.|
|status|object|true|read-only|Status of the line.<br><br>External calls always create valid lines, other line types are managed by the<br>billing engine of OpenMeter.|
|discounts|object|false|read-only|Discounts detailes applied to this line.<br><br>New discounts can be added via the invoice's discounts API, to facilitate<br>discounts that are affecting multiple lines.|
|creditAllocations|[[InvoiceLineCreditAllocation](#schemainvoicelinecreditallocation)]|false|read-only|Credit allocations applied to this line.<br><br>Credits are deducted from the line total before taxes are applied.|
|invoice|object|false|none|The invoice this item belongs to.|
|currency|object|true|none|The currency of this line.|
|taxes|[[InvoiceLineTaxItem](#schemainvoicelinetaxitem)]|false|read-only|Taxes applied to the invoice totals.|
|taxConfig|object|false|none|**Deprecated.** Tax config specify the tax configuration for this line.|
|totals|object|true|read-only|Totals for this line.|
|period|object|true|none|Period of the line item applies to for revenue recognition pruposes.<br><br>Billing always treats periods as start being inclusive and end being exclusive.|
|externalIds|object|false|read-only|External IDs of the invoice in other apps such as Stripe.|
|subscription|object|false|read-only|Subscription are the references to the subscritpions that this line is related to.|
|invoiceAt|string(date-time)|true|none|**Deprecated.** The time this line item should be invoiced.|
|type|string|true|read-only|**Deprecated.** Type of the line.|
|perUnitAmount|object|false|none|**Deprecated.** Price of the item being sold.|
|paymentTerm|object|false|none|**Deprecated.** Payment term of the line.|
|quantity|object|false|none|**Deprecated.** Quantity of the item being sold.|
|rateCard|object|false|none|The rate card that is used for this line.|
|category|object|false|read-only|Category of the flat fee.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|flat_fee|

InvoiceDetailedLineRateCard represents the rate card (intent) for a flat fee line.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|taxConfig|object|false|none|The tax config of the rate card.<br>When undefined, the tax config of the feature or the default tax config of the plan is used.|
|price|object \| null|true|none|The price of the rate card.<br>When null, the feature or service is free.|
|quantity|object|false|none|Quantity of the item being sold.<br><br>Default: 1|
|discounts|object|false|none|The discounts that are applied to the line.|

InvoiceDocumentRef is used to describe a reference to an existing document (invoice).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|object|true|read-only|Type of the document referenced.|
|reason|string|false|read-only|Human readable description on why this reference is here or needs to be used.|
|description|string|false|read-only|Additional details about the document.|
|type|string|true|none|Type of the invoice.|
|issuedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|IssueAt reflects the time the document was issued.|
|number|object|false|read-only|(Serial) Number of the referenced document.|
|url|string(uri)|true|read-only|Link to the source document.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|credit_note_original_invoice|

Omitted fields:
period: Tax period in which the referred document had an effect required by some tax regimes and formats.
stamps: Seals of approval from other organisations that may need to be listed.
ext: 	Extensions for additional codes that may be required.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|object|true|read-only|Type of the document referenced.|
|reason|string|false|read-only|Human readable description on why this reference is here or needs to be used.|
|description|string|false|read-only|Additional details about the document.|

InvoiceUsageBasedLine represents a line item that is sold to the customer based on usage.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|Human-readable name for the resource. Between 1 and 256 characters.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was last updated.|
|deletedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was permanently deleted.|
|id|string|true|none|ID of the line.|
|managedBy|object|true|read-only|managedBy specifies if the line is manually added via the api or managed by OpenMeter.|
|status|object|true|read-only|Status of the line.<br><br>External calls always create valid lines, other line types are managed by the<br>billing engine of OpenMeter.|
|discounts|object|false|read-only|Discounts detailes applied to this line.<br><br>New discounts can be added via the invoice's discounts API, to facilitate<br>discounts that are affecting multiple lines.|
|creditAllocations|[[InvoiceLineCreditAllocation](#schemainvoicelinecreditallocation)]|false|read-only|Credit allocations applied to this line.<br><br>Credits are deducted from the line total before taxes are applied.|
|invoice|object|false|none|The invoice this item belongs to.|
|currency|object|true|none|The currency of this line.|
|taxes|[[InvoiceLineTaxItem](#schemainvoicelinetaxitem)]|false|read-only|Taxes applied to the invoice totals.|
|taxConfig|object|false|none|**Deprecated.** Tax config specify the tax configuration for this line.|
|totals|object|true|read-only|Totals for this line.|
|period|object|true|none|Period of the line item applies to for revenue recognition pruposes.<br><br>Billing always treats periods as start being inclusive and end being exclusive.|
|invoiceAt|string(date-time)|true|none|The time this line item should be invoiced.|
|externalIds|object|false|read-only|External IDs of the invoice in other apps such as Stripe.|
|subscription|object|false|read-only|Subscription are the references to the subscritpions that this line is related to.|
|type|string|true|read-only|**Deprecated.** Type of the line.|
|price|object|false|none|**Deprecated.** Price of the usage-based item being sold.|
|featureKey|string|false|none|**Deprecated.** The feature that the usage is based on.|
|children|[[InvoiceDetailedLine](#schemainvoicedetailedline)]|false|read-only|The lines detailing the item or service sold.|
|rateCard|object|false|none|The rate card that is used for this line.<br><br>The rate card captures the intent of the price and discounts for the usage-based item.|
|quantity|object|false|read-only|The quantity of the item being sold.<br><br>Any usage discounts applied previously are deducted from this quantity.|
|meteredQuantity|object|false|read-only|The quantity of the item that has been metered for the period before any discounts were applied.|
|preLinePeriodQuantity|object|false|read-only|The quantity of the item used before this line's period.<br><br>It is non-zero in case of progressive billing, when this shows how much of the usage was already billed.<br><br>Any usage discounts applied previously are deducted from this quantity.|
|meteredPreLinePeriodQuantity|object|false|read-only|The metered quantity of the item used in before this line's period without any discounts applied.<br><br>It is non-zero in case of progressive billing, when this shows how much of the usage was already billed.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|usage_based|

InvoiceLineTaxBehavior details how the tax item is applied to the base amount.

Inclusive means the tax is included in the base amount.
Exclusive means the tax is added to the base amount.

InvoicePendingLineCreate represents the create model for an invoice line that is sold to the customer based on usage.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|Human-readable name for the resource. Between 1 and 256 characters.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|taxConfig|object|false|none|**Deprecated.** Tax config specify the tax configuration for this line.|
|period|object|true|none|Period of the line item applies to for revenue recognition pruposes.<br><br>Billing always treats periods as start being inclusive and end being exclusive.|
|invoiceAt|string(date-time)|true|none|The time this line item should be invoiced.|
|price|object|false|none|**Deprecated.** Price of the usage-based item being sold.|
|featureKey|string|false|none|**Deprecated.** The feature that the usage is based on.|
|rateCard|object|false|none|The rate card that is used for this line.<br><br>The rate card captures the intent of the price and discounts for the usage-based item.|

InvoicePendingLinesActionFiltersInput specifies which lines to include in the invoice.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|lineIds|[string]|false|none|The pending line items to include in the invoice, if not provided:<br>- all line items that have invoice_at < asOf will be included<br>- [progressive billing only] all usage based line items will be included up to asOf, new<br>usage-based line items will be staged for the rest of the billing cycle<br><br>All lineIDs present in the list, must exists and must be invoicable as of asOf, or the action will fail.|

BillingInvoiceActionInput is the input for creating an invoice.

Invoice creation is always based on already pending line items created by the billingCreateLineByCustomer
operation. Empty invoices are not allowed.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|filters|object|false|none|Filters to apply when creating the invoice.|
|asOf|string(date-time)|false|none|The time as of which the invoice is created.<br><br>If not provided, the current time is used.|
|customerId|string|true|none|The customer ID for which to create the invoice.|
|progressiveBillingOverride|boolean|false|none|Override the progressive billing setting of the customer.<br><br>Can be used to disable/enable progressive billing in case the business logic<br>requires it, if not provided the billing profile's progressive billing setting will be used.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|true|none|Human-readable name for the resource. Between 1 and 256 characters.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|taxConfig|object|false|none|**Deprecated.** Tax config specify the tax configuration for this line.|
|period|object|true|none|Period of the line item applies to for revenue recognition pruposes.<br><br>Billing always treats periods as start being inclusive and end being exclusive.|
|invoiceAt|string(date-time)|true|none|The time this line item should be invoiced.|
|price|object|false|none|**Deprecated.** Price of the usage-based item being sold.|
|featureKey|string|false|none|**Deprecated.** The feature that the usage is based on.|
|rateCard|object|false|none|The rate card that is used for this line.<br><br>The rate card captures the intent of the price and discounts for the usage-based item.|
|quantity|object|true|none|The quantity of the item being sold.|
|preLinePeriodQuantity|object|false|none|The quantity of the item used before this line's period, if the line is billed progressively.|
|id|string|false|none|ID of the line. If not specified it will be auto-generated.<br><br>When discounts are specified, this must be provided, so that the discount can reference it.|

|taxesExclusiveTotal|object|true|read-only|The total amount of taxes that are added on top of amount from the line.|
|taxesTotal|object|true|read-only|The total amount of taxes for this line.|
|total|object|true|read-only|The total amount value of the line after taxes, discounts and commitments.|

InvoiceWorkflowSettings represents the workflow settings used by the invoice.

This is a clone of the billing profile's workflow settings at the time of invoice creation
with customer overrides considered.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apps|object|false|read-only|The apps that will be used to orchestrate the invoice's workflow.|
|sourceBillingProfileId|string|true|read-only|sourceBillingProfileID is the billing profile on which the workflow was based on.<br><br>The profile is snapshotted on invoice creation, after which it can be altered independently<br>of the profile itself.|
|workflow|object|true|none|The workflow details used by this invoice.|

A meter is a configuration that defines how to match and aggregate events.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|read-only|A unique identifier for the resource.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was last updated.|
|deletedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was permanently deleted.|
|name|string|false|none|Human-readable name for the resource. Between 1 and 256 characters.<br>Defaults to the slug if not specified.|
|slug|string|true|none|A unique, human-readable identifier for the meter.<br>Must consist only alphanumeric and underscore characters.|
|aggregation|object|true|none|The aggregation type to use for the meter.|
|eventType|string|true|none|The event type to aggregate.|
|eventFrom|string(date-time)|false|none|The date since the meter should include events.<br>Useful to skip old events.<br>If not specified, all historical events are included.|
|valueProperty|string|false|none|JSONPath expression to extract the value from the ingested event's data property.<br><br>The ingested value for SUM, AVG, MIN, and MAX aggregations is a number or a string that can be parsed to a number.<br><br>For UNIQUE_COUNT aggregation, the ingested value must be a string. For COUNT aggregation the valueProperty is ignored.|
|groupBy|object|false|none|Named JSONPath expressions to extract the group by values from the event data.<br><br>Keys must be unique and consist only alphanumeric and underscore characters.|
|annotations|object \| null|false|read-only|Set of key-value pairs managed by the system. Cannot be modified by user.|

|---|---|---|---|---|
|clientId|string|false|none|Client ID<br>Useful to track progress of a query.|

|advancedMeterGroupByFilters|object|false|none|Optional advanced meter group by filters.<br>You can use this to filter for values of the meter groupBy fields.|

Payload for notification event with `invoice.created` type.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|read-only|A unique identifier for the notification event the payload belongs to.|
|type|string|true|read-only|Type of the notification event.|
|timestamp|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp when the notification event was created in RFC 3339 format.|
|data|object|true|read-only|The data of the payload.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|invoice.created|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|type|string|true|read-only|Type of the notification event.|
|timestamp|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp when the notification event was created in RFC 3339 format.|
|data|object|true|read-only|The data of the payload.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|invoice.updated|

<h2 id="tocS_NotificationRuleBalanceThresholdValueType">NotificationRuleBalanceThresholdValueType</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemanotificationrulebalancethresholdvaluetype"></a>
<a id="schema_NotificationRuleBalanceThresholdValueType"></a>
<a id="tocSnotificationrulebalancethresholdvaluetype"></a>
<a id="tocsnotificationrulebalancethresholdvaluetype"></a>

```json
"PERCENT"
```

Type of the rule in the balance threshold specification:
* `balance_value`: threshold defined by the remaining balance value based on usage and the total of grants in the current usage period
* `usage_percentage`: threshold defined by the usage percentage compared to the total of grants in the current usage period
* `usage_value`: threshold defined by the usage value in the current usage period
* `NUMBER` (**deprecated**): see `usage_value`
* `PERCENT` (**deprecated**): see `usage_percentage`

<h2 id="tocS_PackagePrice">PackagePrice</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapackageprice"></a>
<a id="schema_PackagePrice"></a>
<a id="tocSpackageprice"></a>
<a id="tocspackageprice"></a>

```json
{
  "type": "package",
  "amount": {},
  "quantityPerPackage": {}
}
```

Package price.

The item is sold in packages. Each package contains quantityPerPackage items, the price of the
package is set in amount.

The total price of the usage will be enough packages that can accomodate all the usage.

Examples (given a package size of 20, and an amount of $10):
- if the quantity is 98, the price will be 5*$10=$50.
- if the quantity is zero, the price will be 0*$10=$0, as even the first package is not purchased.
- if the quantity is 20, the price will be 1*$10=$10, as the usage fits into the first package.
- if the quantity is 20.1, the price will be 2*$10=$20, as the additional 0.1 usage (compared to the
previous example) requires a new package.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|string|true|none|The type of the price.|
|amount|object|true|none|The price of one package.|
|quantityPerPackage|object|true|none|The quantity per package.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|package|

|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was last updated.|
|deletedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was permanently deleted.|
|key|string|true|none|A semi-unique identifier for the resource.|
|alignment|object|false|none|Alignment configuration for the plan.|
|version|integer|true|read-only|Version of the plan. Incremented when the plan is updated.|
|currency|object|true|none|The currency code of the plan.|
|billingCadence|string(duration)|true|none|The default billing cadence for subscriptions using this plan.<br>Defines how often customers are billed using ISO8601 duration format.<br>Examples: "P1M" (monthly), "P3M" (quarterly), "P1Y" (annually).|
|proRatingConfig|object|false|none|Default pro-rating configuration for subscriptions using this plan.|
|effectiveFrom|string(date-time)|false|read-only|The date and time when the plan becomes effective. When not specified, the plan is a draft.|
|effectiveTo|string(date-time)|false|read-only|The date and time when the plan is no longer effective. When not specified, the plan is effective indefinitely.|
|status|object|true|read-only|The status of the plan.<br>Computed based on the effective start and end dates:<br>- draft = no effectiveFrom<br>- active = effectiveFrom <= now < effectiveTo<br>- archived / inactive = effectiveTo <= now<br>- scheduled = now < effectiveFrom < effectiveTo|
|settlementMode|object|false|none|The settlement mode of the plan.<br>It determines how the billing system generates invoices and credits for the subscriptions using this plan.<br>- credit_then_invoice: credits from the previous billing period are applied first, then the remaining balance is invoiced.<br>- credit_only: only credits from the previous billing period are generated and applied. No invoices are generated for the subscription.<br>This is the default and most common settlement mode.|
|phases|[[PlanPhase](#schemaplanphase)]|true|none|The plan phase or pricing ramp allows changing a plan's rate cards over time as a subscription progresses.<br>A phase switch occurs only at the end of a billing period, ensuring that a single subscription invoice will not include charges from different phase prices.|
|validationErrors|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|true|read-only|List of validation errors.|

|*oneOf*|[DynamicPrice](#schemadynamicprice)|false|none|Dynamic price.<br><br>The underlying meter's value is considered the base price in the<br>customer's currency.<br><br>The rate specifies the markup over the price.|
|*oneOf*|[PackagePrice](#schemapackageprice)|false|none|Package price.<br><br>The item is sold in packages. Each package contains quantityPerPackage items, the price of the<br>package is set in amount.<br><br>The total price of the usage will be enough packages that can accomodate all the usage.<br><br>Examples (given a package size of 20, and an amount of $10):<br>- if the quantity is 98, the price will be 5*$10=$50.<br>- if the quantity is zero, the price will be 0*$10=$0, as even the first package is not purchased.<br>- if the quantity is 20, the price will be 1*$10=$10, as the usage fits into the first package.<br>- if the quantity is 20.1, the price will be 2*$10=$20, as the additional 0.1 usage (compared to the<br>previous example) requires a new package.|

<h2 id="tocS_Subject">Subject</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemasubject"></a>
<a id="schema_Subject"></a>
<a id="tocSsubject"></a>
<a id="tocssubject"></a>

```json
{
  "createdAt": "2025-01-01T01:01:01.001Z",
  "updatedAt": "2025-02-01T01:01:01.001Z",
  "deletedAt": "2025-03-01T01:01:01.001Z",
  "id": "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH",
  "key": "customer-id",
  "displayName": "Customer Name",
  "metadata": {
    "hubspotId": "123456"
  },
  "stripeCustomerId": "cus_JMOlctsKV8"
}
```

A subject is a unique identifier for a usage attribution by its key.
Subjects only exist in the concept of metering.
Subjects are optional to create and work as an enrichment for the subject key like displayName, metadata, etc.
Subjects are useful when you are reporting usage events with your own database ID but want to enrich the subject with a human-readable name or metadata.
For most use cases, a subject is equivalent to a customer.

⚠️ __Deprecated__: Subjects as managable entities are being depracated, use customers with subject key usage attribution instead.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was last updated.|
|deletedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was permanently deleted.|
|id|string|true|read-only|A unique identifier for the subject.|
|key|string|true|none|A unique, human-readable identifier for the subject.<br>This is typically a database ID or a customer key.|
|displayName|string \| null|false|none|A human-readable display name for the subject.|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Metadata for the subject.|
|currentPeriodStart|string(date-time)|false|none|**Deprecated.** The start of the current period for the subject.|
|currentPeriodEnd|string(date-time)|false|none|**Deprecated.** The end of the current period for the subject.|
|stripeCustomerId|string \| null|false|none|**Deprecated.** The Stripe customer ID for the subject.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|read-only|A unique identifier for the resource.|
|name|string|true|none|Human-readable name for the resource. Between 1 and 256 characters.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was last updated.|
|deletedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was permanently deleted.|
|activeFrom|string(date-time)|true|none|The cadence start of the resource.|
|activeTo|string(date-time)|false|none|The cadence end of the resource.|
|annotations|object|false|read-only|Set of key-value pairs managed by the system. Cannot be modified by user.|
|alignment|object|false|none|Alignment configuration for the plan.|
|status|object|true|read-only|The status of the subscription.|
|customerId|string|true|none|The customer ID of the subscription.|
|plan|object|false|none|The plan of the subscription.|
|currency|object|true|none|The fiat currency in which the subscription is invoiced.|
|costBasisMode|object|true|read-only|Controls whether custom-currency cost bases are resolved dynamically or pinned<br>when their currency pair is introduced to the subscription.|
|costBasisPins|[[SubscriptionCostBasisPin](#schemasubscriptioncostbasispin)]|true|read-only|Cost bases pinned to custom-currency pairs for this subscription.|
|billingCadence|string(duration)|true|read-only|The billing cadence for the subscriptions.<br>Defines how often customers are billed using ISO8601 duration format.<br>Examples: "P1M" (monthly), "P3M" (quarterly), "P1Y" (annually).|
|proRatingConfig|object|false|read-only|The pro-rating configuration for the subscriptions.|
|billingAnchor|string(date-time)|true|read-only|The normalizedbilling anchor of the subscription.|
|settlementMode|object|true|read-only|The settlement mode of the subscription.<br>- credit_then_invoice: credits from the previous billing period are applied first, then the remaining balance is invoiced.<br>- credit_only: only credits from the previous billing period are generated and applied. No invoices are generated for the subscription.<br>This is the default and most common settlement mode.|

|instance|string(uri)|true|none|A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.|
|extensions|object|false|none|Additional properties specific to the problem type may be present.|

|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was created.|

|activeFrom|string(date-time)|true|none|The cadence start of the resource.|
|activeTo|string(date-time)|false|none|The cadence end of the resource.|
|annotations|object|false|read-only|Set of key-value pairs managed by the system. Cannot be modified by user.|
|status|object|true|read-only|The status of the subscription.|
|customerId|string|true|none|The customer ID of the subscription.|
|plan|object|false|none|The plan of the subscription.|
|currency|object|true|none|The fiat currency in which the subscription is invoiced.|
|costBasisMode|object|true|read-only|Controls whether custom-currency cost bases are resolved dynamically or pinned<br>when their currency pair is introduced to the subscription.|
|costBasisPins|[[SubscriptionCostBasisPin](#schemasubscriptioncostbasispin)]|true|read-only|Cost bases pinned to custom-currency pairs for this subscription.|
|billingCadence|string(duration)|true|read-only|The billing cadence for the subscriptions.<br>Defines how often customers are billed using ISO8601 duration format.<br>Examples: "P1M" (monthly), "P3M" (quarterly), "P1Y" (annually).|
|proRatingConfig|object|false|read-only|The pro-rating configuration for the subscriptions.|
|billingAnchor|string(date-time)|true|read-only|The normalizedbilling anchor of the subscription.|
|settlementMode|object|true|read-only|The settlement mode of the subscription.<br>- credit_then_invoice: credits from the previous billing period are applied first, then the remaining balance is invoiced.<br>- credit_only: only credits from the previous billing period are generated and applied. No invoices are generated for the subscription.<br>This is the default and most common settlement mode.|
|alignment|object|false|none|Alignment details enriched with the current billing period.|
|phases|[[SubscriptionPhaseExpanded](#schemasubscriptionphaseexpanded)]|true|none|The phases of the subscription.|

The actual contents of the Subscription, what the user gets, what they pay, etc...

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|read-only|A unique identifier for the resource.|
|name|string|true|none|Human-readable name for the resource. Between 1 and 256 characters.|
|description|string|false|none|Optional description of the resource. Maximum 1024 characters.|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Additional metadata for the resource.|
|createdAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was created.|
|updatedAt|string(date-time)|true|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was last updated.|
|deletedAt|string(date-time)|false|read-only|Timestamp of when the resource was permanently deleted.|
|activeFrom|string(date-time)|true|none|The cadence start of the resource.|
|activeTo|string(date-time)|false|none|The cadence end of the resource.|
|key|string|true|none|The identifier of the RateCard.<br>SubscriptionItem/RateCard can be identified, it has a reference:<br><br>1. If a Feature is associated with the SubscriptionItem, it is identified by the Feature<br>1.1 It can be an ID reference, for an exact version of the Feature (Features can change across versions)<br>1.2 It can be a Key reference, which always refers to the latest (active or inactive) version of a Feature<br><br>2. If a Feature is not associated with the SubscriptionItem, it is referenced by the Price<br><br>We say "referenced by the Price" regardless of how a price itself is referenced, it colloquially makes sense to say "paying the same price for the same thing". In practice this should be derived from what's printed on the invoice line-item.|
|currency|object|false|read-only|The materialized currency of the item's rate card. Present for priced items.|
|featureKey|string|false|none|The feature's key (if present).|
|billingCadence|string(duration) \| null|true|none|The billing cadence of the rate card.<br>When null, the rate card is a one-time purchase.|
|price|object \| null|true|none|The price of the rate card.<br>When null, the feature or service is free.|
|discounts|object|false|none|The discounts applied to the rate card.|
|included|object|false|none|Describes what access is gained via the SubscriptionItem|
|taxConfig|object|false|none|The tax config of the Subscription Item.<br>When undefined, the tax config of the feature or the default tax config of the plan is used.|

|discounts|object|false|none|The discounts on the plan.|
|key|string|true|none|A locally unique identifier for the phase.|
|name|string|true|none|The name of the phase.|
|description|string|false|none|The description of the phase.|

The structure is flattened to better conform to the Plan API.<br>The timelines are flattened according to the following rules:<br>- for the current phase, the `items` contains only the active item for each key<br>- for past phases, the `items` contains only the last item for each key<br>- for future phases, the `items` contains only the first version of the item for each key|
